local DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {

	TIME_VARIANCE = 0.07;

	COMPARISON_CHECKS = 3;

	JUMP_WHEN_STUCK = false;
}

---------------------------------------------------------------------

local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local function output(func, msg)
	func(((func == error and "SimplePath Error: ") or "SimplePath: ")..msg)
end
local Path = {
	StatusType = {
		Idle = "Idle";
		Active = "Active";
	};
	ErrorType = {
		LimitReached = "LimitReached";
		TargetUnreachable = "TargetUnreachable";
		ComputationError = "ComputationError";
		AgentStuck = "AgentStuck";
	};
}
Path.__index = function(table, index)
	if index == "Stopped" and not table._humanoid then
		output(error, "Attempt to use Path.Stopped on a non-humanoid.")
	end
	return (table._events[index] and table._events[index].Event)
		or (index == "LastError" and table._lastError)
		or (index == "Status" and table._status)
		or Path[index]
end

--Used to visualize waypoints
local visualWaypoint = Instance.new("Part")
visualWaypoint.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
visualWaypoint.Anchored = true
visualWaypoint.CanCollide = false
visualWaypoint.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
visualWaypoint.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball

--[[ PRIVATE FUNCTIONS ]]--
local function declareError(self, errorType)
	self._lastError = errorType
	self._events.Error:Fire(errorType)
end

--Create visual waypoints
local function createVisualWaypoints(waypoints)
	local visualWaypoints = {}
	for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
		local visualWaypointClone = visualWaypoint:Clone()
		visualWaypointClone.Position = waypoint.Position
		visualWaypointClone.Parent = workspace
		visualWaypointClone.Color =
			(waypoint == waypoints[#waypoints] and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0))
			or (waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
			or Color3.fromRGB(255, 139, 0)
		table.insert(visualWaypoints, visualWaypointClone)
	end
	return visualWaypoints
end

--Destroy visual waypoints
local function destroyVisualWaypoints(waypoints)
	if waypoints then
		for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
			waypoint:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return
end

--Get initial waypoint for non-humanoid
local function getNonHumanoidWaypoint(self)
	--Account for multiple waypoints that are sometimes in the same place
	for i = 2, #self._waypoints do
		if (self._waypoints[i].Position - self._waypoints[i - 1].Position).Magnitude > 0.1 then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 2
end

--Make NPC jump
local function setJumpState(self)
	pcall(function()
		if self._humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and self._humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
			self._humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		end
	end)
end

--Primary move function
local function move(self)
	if self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint].Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
		setJumpState(self)
	end
	self._humanoid:MoveTo(self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint].Position)
end

--Disconnect MoveToFinished connection when pathfinding ends
local function disconnectMoveConnection(self)
	self._moveConnection:Disconnect()
	self._moveConnection = nil
end

--Fire the WaypointReached event
local function invokeWaypointReached(self)
	local lastWaypoint = self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint - 1]
	local nextWaypoint = self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint]
	self._events.WaypointReached:Fire(self._agent, lastWaypoint, nextWaypoint)
end

local function moveToFinished(self, reached)
	
	--Stop execution if Path is destroyed
	if not getmetatable(self) then return end

	--Handle case for non-humanoids
	if not self._humanoid then
		if reached and self._currentWaypoint + 1 <= #self._waypoints then
			invokeWaypointReached(self)
			self._currentWaypoint += 1
		elseif reached then
			self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
			self._target = nil
			self._events.Reached:Fire(self._agent, self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint])
		else
			self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
			self._target = nil
			declareError(self, self.ErrorType.TargetUnreachable)
		end
		return
	end

	if reached and self._currentWaypoint + 1 <= #self._waypoints  then --Waypoint reached
		if self._currentWaypoint + 1 < #self._waypoints then
			invokeWaypointReached(self)
		end
		self._currentWaypoint += 1
		move(self)
	elseif reached then --Target reached, pathfinding ends
		disconnectMoveConnection(self)
		self._status = Path.StatusType.Idle
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
		self._events.Reached:Fire(self._agent, self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint])
	else --Target unreachable
		disconnectMoveConnection(self)
		self._status = Path.StatusType.Idle
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
		declareError(self, self.ErrorType.TargetUnreachable)
	end
end

--Refer to Settings.COMPARISON_CHECKS
local function comparePosition(self)
	if self._currentWaypoint == #self._waypoints then return end
	self._position._count = ((self._agent.PrimaryPart.Position - self._position._last).Magnitude <= 0.07 and (self._position._count + 1)) or 0
	self._position._last = self._agent.PrimaryPart.Position
	if self._position._count >= self._settings.COMPARISON_CHECKS then
		if self._settings.JUMP_WHEN_STUCK then
			setJumpState(self)
		end
		declareError(self, self.ErrorType.AgentStuck)
	end
end

--[[ STATIC METHODS ]]--
function Path.GetNearestCharacter(fromPosition)
	local character, dist = nil, math.huge
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character and (player.Character.PrimaryPart.Position - fromPosition).Magnitude < dist then
			character, dist = player.Character, (player.Character.PrimaryPart.Position - fromPosition).Magnitude
		end
	end
	return character
end

--[[ CONSTRUCTOR ]]--
function Path.new(agent, agentParameters, override)
	if not (agent and agent:IsA("Model") and agent.PrimaryPart) then
		output(error, "Pathfinding agent must be a valid Model Instance with a set PrimaryPart.")
	end

	local self = setmetatable({
		_settings = override or DEFAULT_SETTINGS;
		_events = {
			Reached = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
			WaypointReached = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
			Blocked = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
			Error = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
			Stopped = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
		};
		_agent = agent;
		_humanoid = agent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
		_path = PathfindingService:CreatePath(agentParameters);
		_status = "Idle";
		_t = 0;
		_position = {
			_last = Vector3.new();
			_count = 0;
		};
	}, Path)

	--Configure settings
	for setting, value in pairs(DEFAULT_SETTINGS) do
		self._settings[setting] = self._settings[setting] == nil and value or self._settings[setting]
	end

	--Path blocked connection
	self._path.Blocked:Connect(function(...)
		if (self._currentWaypoint <= ... and self._currentWaypoint + 1 >= ...) and self._humanoid then
			setJumpState(self)
			self._events.Blocked:Fire(self._agent, self._waypoints[...])
		end
	end)

	return self
end


--[[ NON-STATIC METHODS ]]--
function Path:Destroy()
	for _, event in ipairs(self._events) do
		event:Destroy()
	end
	self._events = nil
	if rawget(self, "_visualWaypoints") then
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
	end
	self._path:Destroy()
	setmetatable(self, nil)
	for k, _ in pairs(self) do
		self[k] = nil
	end
end

function Path:Stop()
	if not self._humanoid then
		output(error, "Attempt to call Path:Stop() on a non-humanoid.")
		return
	end
	if self._status == Path.StatusType.Idle then
		output(function(m)
			warn(debug.traceback(m))
		end, "Attempt to run Path:Stop() in idle state")
		return
	end
	disconnectMoveConnection(self)
	self._status = Path.StatusType.Idle
	self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
	self._events.Stopped:Fire(self._model)
end

function Path:Run(target)

	--Non-humanoid handle case
	if not target and not self._humanoid and self._target then
		moveToFinished(self, true)
		return
	end

	--Parameter check
	if not (target and (typeof(target) == "Vector3" or target:IsA("BasePart"))) then
		output(error, "Pathfinding target must be a valid Vector3 or BasePart.")
	end

	--Refer to Settings.TIME_VARIANCE
	if os.clock() - self._t <= self._settings.TIME_VARIANCE and self._humanoid then
		task.wait(os.clock() - self._t)
		declareError(self, self.ErrorType.LimitReached)
		return false
	elseif self._humanoid then
		self._t = os.clock()
	end

	--Compute path
	local pathComputed, _ = pcall(function()
		self._path:ComputeAsync(self._agent.PrimaryPart.Position, (typeof(target) == "Vector3" and target) or target.Position)
	end)

	--Make sure path computation is successful
	if not pathComputed
		or self._path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.NoPath
		or #self._path:GetWaypoints() < 2
		or (self._humanoid and self._humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall) then
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
		task.wait()
		declareError(self, self.ErrorType.ComputationError)
		return false
	end

	--Set status to active; pathfinding starts
	self._status = (self._humanoid and Path.StatusType.Active) or Path.StatusType.Idle
	self._target = target

	--Set network owner to server to prevent "hops"
	pcall(function()
		self._agent.PrimaryPart:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end)

	--Initialize waypoints
	self._waypoints = self._path:GetWaypoints()
	self._currentWaypoint = 2

	--Refer to Settings.COMPARISON_CHECKS
	if self._humanoid then
		comparePosition(self)
	end

	--Visualize waypoints
	destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
	self._visualWaypoints = (self.Visualize and createVisualWaypoints(self._waypoints))

	--Create a new move connection if it doesn't exist already
	self._moveConnection = self._humanoid and (self._moveConnection or self._humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function(...)
		moveToFinished(self, ...)
	end))

	--Begin pathfinding
	if self._humanoid then
		self._humanoid:MoveTo(self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint].Position)
	elseif #self._waypoints == 2 then
		self._target = nil
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
		self._events.Reached:Fire(self._agent, self._waypoints[2])
	else
		self._currentWaypoint = getNonHumanoidWaypoint(self)
		moveToFinished(self, true)
	end
	return true
end

return Path

FILE_END: ReplicatedStorage.Subject-0001.AI.__path

local function getTableIndex(t: "Table")
	local n = 0
	for _,_ in pairs(t) do
		n += 1

function isHumanoid(part: BasePart)
	if part and part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		return part.Parent
	elseif part and part.Parent and part.Parent ~= workspace then
		return isHumanoid(part.Parent)
	end

	return false
end

local function isObstacle(p1, p2, params)
	local cast = workspace:Raycast((typeof(p1) == "Instance" and p1.Position or p1), (typeof(p2) == "Instance" and p2.Position or p2) - (typeof(p1) == "Instance" and p1.Position or p1), params)
	if config.debugMode then
		if cast then
			debug:debugLine((typeof(p1) == "Instance" and p1.Position or p1), cast.Position - (typeof(p1) == "Instance" and p1.Position or p1), 1.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0))
		else
			debug:debugLine((typeof(p1) == "Instance" and p1.Position or p1), (typeof(p2) == "Instance" and p2.Position or p2) - (typeof(p1) == "Instance" and p1.Position or p1), 1.5, nil, nil, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
		end
	end
	
	return cast
end

local function getRandomChild(parent)
	return parent:GetChildren()[math.random(#parent:GetChildren())]
end

local function getDistance(p1, p2)
	return ((typeof(p1) == "Instance" and p1.Position or p1) - (typeof(p2) == "Instance" and p2.Position or p2)).magnitude
end

local function clampDistanceBetweenVectors(V1, V2, Max) -- V1 is origin.
	return V1 + ((V2 - V1).Unit * math.min((V2 - V1).Magnitude,  Max))
end

local function angleBetween(vectorA: Vector3, vectorB: Vector3)
	return math.acos(math.clamp(vectorA:Dot(vectorB), -1, 1))
end

local function isInFOV(target: BasePart, fov: number)
	local lookForward = humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector
	local lookToPoint = (target.CFrame.Position - humanoid.RootPart.Position).unit
	local angle = angleBetween(lookForward, lookToPoint)
	return math.abs(angle) <= math.rad(fov)
end

local function isGun(tool: Tool)
	return tool:GetAttribute("Arms") and not tool:GetAttribute("Melee")
end

local function isMelee(tool: Tool)
	return tool:GetAttribute("Arms") and tool:GetAttribute("Melee")
end

local function detectTarget(part: BasePart)
	return isInFOV(part, config.fov) or getDistance(part, humanoid.RootPart) <= config.targetCloseRangeNotice
end

local function getTargets(findRadius: number, ignoreObstacles: boolean, ignoreFOV: boolean, isAllies: boolean, includeDeadTarget: boolean)
	local targets = {}
	local hitted = {}
	local collideParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(humanoid.RootPart.Position, findRadius, config.targetOverlapParams)
	for _,part in pairs(collideParts) do
		local target = isHumanoid(part)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, target or part, workspace.Ignored}
		if target and target:IsDescendantOf(config.characters) and target ~= character and target:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and (not target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Team") or not isAllies and target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Team") ~= humanoid:GetAttribute("Team") or isAllies and target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Team") == humanoid:GetAttribute("Team")) and target.Humanoid.RootPart and (target.Humanoid.Health > 0 or includeDeadTarget) and not hitted[target] and part.Parent == target and not target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField") and (ignoreObstacles or not isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, part, params)) and (isInFOV(part, config.fov) or ignoreFOV or getDistance(part, humanoid.RootPart) <= config.targetCloseRangeNotice) then
			hitted[target] = true
			targets[#targets + 1] = target
		end
	end
	
	table.clear(hitted)
	
	return targets
end

local function findClosedTarget(findRadius: number, ignoreObstacles: boolean, ignoreFOV: boolean, isAllies: boolean, includeDeadTarget: boolean)
	if humanoid.RootPart then
		local target, dist = nil, math.huge
		
		local targets = getTargets(findRadius, ignoreObstacles, ignoreFOV, isAllies, includeDeadTarget)		
		for _,v in pairs(targets) do
			local targetDist = getDistance(v.Humanoid.RootPart, humanoid.RootPart)
			if targetDist < dist then
				target = v
				dist = targetDist
			end
		end
		
		table.clear(targets)
		
		return target, dist
	end
	
	return false
end

local function checkLadder(part: BasePart)
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {config.characters, workspace.Ignored}
	local collideParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(part and part.Position or humanoid.RootPart.Position, 3, overlapParams)
	for _,v in pairs(collideParts) do
		if v:IsA("TrussPart") then
			return v
		end
	end
	
	return false
end

local function canJump(params: RaycastParams?)
	return not isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, humanoid.RootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, humanoid.JumpPower ^ 2 / (2 * workspace.Gravity), 0), params)
end

local function unequipTools()
	for _,v in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Tool") then
			v.Parent = backpack
		end
	end
end

local function equipTool(tool: Tool | string)
	unequipTools()
	if typeof(tool) == "Instance" then
		tool.Parent = character
	else
		local backpackTool = backpack:FindFirstChild(tool)
		if backpackTool then
			backpackTool.Parent = character
		end
	end
end

local function stopPaths(hash: string)
	if hash then
		activePaths[hash] = false
	else
		for hash,_ in pairs(activePaths) do
			activePaths[hash] = false
		end
	end
end

local function moveTo(point: Vector3, timeout: number)
	task.spawn(function()
		stopPaths()
		local hash = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
		activePaths[hash] = true

		local status = {
			reached = false,
			blocked = false,
			error = false,

			skipped = false,
		}

		local connections = {}
		table.insert(connections, path.Reached:Connect(function()
			status.reached = true
		end))

		table.insert(connections, path.Blocked:Connect(function(_, waypoint)
			status.blocked = true
			status.skipped = true
			
			humanoid.Jump = true
		end))

		table.insert(connections, path.Error:Connect(function(errorType)
			status.error = true
			status.skipped = true
			
			if errorType == "AgentStuck" and humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
				humanoid.Jump = true
			end
		end))
		
		if humanoid.Sit then
			humanoid.Jump = true
		end

		if not character:GetAttribute("meleeFinisher") then
			pcall(function() 
				local computed = path:Run(point)
			end)
		end

		local t = tick()
		while tick() - t < timeout and not status.reached and not status.skipped and activePaths[hash] do
			task.wait(config.rate)
		end
		
		_disconnectEvents(connections)
		table.clear(status)
		activePaths[hash] = nil
	end)
end

local function findCover(fromPart: BasePart, fromPartModel: Model)
	local coverSpots = {}
	for _,pos in pairs(config.findCoverGrid) do
		local origin = (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(pos)).p
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {fromPartModel or fromPart, character, workspace.Ignored, config.characters}
		local cast = workspace:Raycast(origin, fromPart.CFrame.LookVector * -config.findCoverDist, params)
		if config.debugMode then
			if cast then
				debug:debugLine(origin, cast.Position - origin, 0.5)
			else
				debug:debugLine(origin, fromPart.CFrame.LookVector * -config.findCoverDist, 0.5, nil, nil, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
			end
		end
		
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, fromPartModel or fromPart, workspace.Ignored}
		local addPos = (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(pos.x, 0, 0).unit * 2.5)).p - humanoid.RootPart.Position
		if cast and isObstacle(fromPart.Position, cast.Position + cast.Normal + addPos, params) then
			coverSpots[#coverSpots + 1] = {cast, addPos}
		end
	end
	
	local spot, pos, dist = nil, nil, math.huge
	for _,v in pairs(coverSpots) do
		local spotDist = getDistance(v[1].Position, humanoid.RootPart)
		if spotDist < dist then
			spot = v[1]
			pos = v[2]
			dist = spotDist
		end
	end
	
	return spot, pos
end

local function takeCover(jump: boolean, reload: boolean, rush: boolean)
	if not states.coverDamage and states.target then
		states.coverDamage = true
		local cover,pos = findCover(states.target.part, states.target.character)
		if cover then
			if rush then
				states.run = true
			end
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, states.target.character, workspace.Ignored}
			if jump and math.random(2) == 1 and canJump(params) then
				humanoid.Jump = true
			end
			local dist = cover.Position + cover.Normal + pos
			local timeout = getDistance(dist, humanoid.RootPart) + 0.5
			moveTo(dist, 1)
			local t = tick()
			task.wait(timeout / humanoid.WalkSpeed)
			local reloaded = false
			if reload and equippedTool and (not states.target or isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, states.target.part, params)) then
				reloaded = true
				equippedTool.activateEvent:Fire(Enum.KeyCode.R, "began")
			elseif not reload and (not states.target or isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, states.target.part, params)) then
				states.run = false
			end
			
			local strafeTick = 0
			local strafeSwapTick = 0
			local strafePos = math.random(1, 2)
			while tick() - t < 3 do
				local coverTarget,_ = findClosedTarget(config.findTargetRadius)
				if coverTarget then
					if not states.target or states.target.character ~= coverTarget then
						states.target = {part = coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart, character = coverTarget}
						params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, states.target.character, workspace.Ignored}
					end
					if coverTarget.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") then
						break
					end
					local params = RaycastParams.new()
					params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, coverTarget, workspace.Ignored}
					if getDistance(coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart, humanoid.RootPart) > 5 and not isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart, params) then
						local cover,pos = findCover(coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart, coverTarget)
						if cover then
							local dist = cover.Position + cover.Normal + pos
							local timeout = getDistance(dist, humanoid.RootPart) + 0.5
							if config.debugMode then
								debug:point(dist, 1.5)
							end
							moveTo(dist, 1)
							task.wait(timeout / humanoid.WalkSpeed)
							if reload and equippedTool and not reloaded and (not coverTarget:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart or isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart, params)) then
								equippedTool.activateEvent:Fire(Enum.KeyCode.R, "began")
								states.run = false
							elseif not reload and (not coverTarget:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart or isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart, params)) then
								states.run = false
							end
							t = tick()
						else
							moveTo(clampDistanceBetweenVectors(coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart.Position, humanoid.RootPart.Position, 20), 1)
						end
					else
						if canJump(params) and math.random(5) == 1 then
							humanoid.Jump = true
						end
						moveTo(clampDistanceBetweenVectors(coverTarget.Humanoid.RootPart.Position, humanoid.RootPart.Position, 20), 1)
					end
				else
					local strafeDir = {
						humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 5, 
						humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.RightVector * -5,
					}

					if tick() - strafeTick >= 0.5 and not character:GetAttribute("meleeFinisher") then
						strafeTick = tick()
						humanoid:MoveTo(humanoid.RootPart.Position + strafeDir[math.random(#strafeDir)] + strafeDir[strafePos])
						if tick() - strafeSwapTick >= 3 then
							strafeSwapTick = tick()
							strafePos = math.random(1, 2)
						end
					end
				end

				task.wait(config.rate)
			end
		else
			moveTo(clampDistanceBetweenVectors(states.target.part.Position, humanoid.RootPart.Position, 100), 1)
			if reload and equippedTool then
				equippedTool.activateEvent:Fire(Enum.KeyCode.R, "began")
			end
		end
		states.coverDamage = false
	elseif reload and equippedTool then
		equippedTool.activateEvent:Fire(Enum.KeyCode.R, "began")
	end
end

local function enemy()
	local target,_ = findClosedTarget(config.findTargetRadius, false, tick() - states.damageAlertTick < 0.5)
	if target then
		states.alertTick = tick()
		stopPaths()
		states.target = {part = target.Humanoid.RootPart, character = target}
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, states.target.character, workspace.Ignored}
		local takeCoverFast = getDistance(states.target.part, humanoid.RootPart) <= 15 and (not equippedTool or isGun(equippedTool))
		if math.random(2) == 1 or takeCoverFast or #getTargets(config.findTargetRadius * 1.5) >= config.fallBackEnemyCountOnFight and #getTargets(config.findTargetRadius, false, true, true) < config.stayAlliesCountOnFight then
			if not target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") then
				takeCover(false, false, takeCoverFast and true)
			end
		end
		local onSightTick = tick()
		
		local strafeTick = 0
		local strafeSwapTick = 0
		local strafePos = math.random(1, 2)
		
		local lastSeenPosition = states.target.part.Position
		local lostSightRadius = Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), 0, math.random(-5, 5))
		character:SetAttribute("aim", true)
		lastTargetAlertPos = states.target.part.Position
		local originRootPos = humanoid.RootPart.Position
		if equippedTool and isMelee(equippedTool) then
			states.run = true
		end
		while target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and target.Humanoid.Health > 0 and target.Humanoid.RootPart and getDistance(target.Humanoid.RootPart, humanoid.RootPart) < config.forgetTargetOnFarDistance do
			local onSight = not isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, states.target.part, params)
			if onSight and detectTarget(states.target.part) or checkLadder() then
				onSightTick = tick()
				lastSeenPosition = states.target.part.Position
				lostSightRadius = Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), 0, math.random(-5, 5))
			elseif tick() - onSightTick >= config.forgetTargetOnSightLost then
				lastTargetPos = lastSeenPosition
				lastTargetAlertPos = lastSeenPosition
				break
			--[[elseif not onSight and target.Humanoid.Health > 50 and equippedTool and isGun(equippedTool) then
				takeCover(false, false, true)]]
			end
			
			if math.random(5) == 1 and not states.target.character.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and #getTargets(config.findTargetRadius) >= config.fallBackEnemyCountOnFight and #getTargets(config.findTargetRadius, false, true, true) < config.stayAlliesCountOnFight or humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") then
				takeCover(false, false, true)
			end
			
			if equippedTool and isGun(equippedTool) and not states.target.character.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and ((equippedTool._data.magCurrent.Value / equippedTool._data.magSize.Value) * 1 <= 0.3 and math.random(3) == 1 or equippedTool._data.magCurrent.Value <= 0) and equippedTool._data.ammo.Value > 0 then
				takeCover(false, true, true)
			end
			
			local otherCloserTarget,_ = findClosedTarget(config.findTargetRadius)
			if otherCloserTarget and otherCloserTarget ~= target then
				target = otherCloserTarget
				states.target = {part = target.Humanoid.RootPart, character = target}
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, states.target.character, workspace.Ignored}
				originRootPos = humanoid.RootPart.Position
			end
			
			local ladderPart = checkLadder()
			local targetIsClimbing = checkLadder(states.target.part) == ladderPart and ladderPart ~= false
			if targetIsClimbing then
				moveTo(ladderPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, ladderPart.Size.y / 2, 0), 1)
			else
				if equippedTool and isGun(equippedTool) then
					local strafeDir = {
						humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 5, 
						humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.RightVector * -5,
					}
					
					if getDistance(originRootPos, lastSeenPosition) < config.gunMinCloseFromOriginDist then
						if onSight then
							moveTo(clampDistanceBetweenVectors(lastSeenPosition + strafeDir[math.random(#strafeDir)], originRootPos, config.gunMinCloseFromOriginDist), 1)
						else
							moveTo(lastSeenPosition + lostSightRadius + strafeDir[math.random(#strafeDir)], 1)
						end
					elseif tick() - strafeTick >= 0.5 and not character:GetAttribute("meleeFinisher") then
						strafeTick = tick()
						humanoid:MoveTo(humanoid.RootPart.Position + strafeDir[math.random(#strafeDir)] + strafeDir[strafePos])
						if tick() - strafeSwapTick >= 3 then
							strafeSwapTick = tick()
							strafePos = math.random(1, 2)
						end
					end
				elseif equippedTool and isMelee(equippedTool) then
					moveTo(onSight and clampDistanceBetweenVectors(lastSeenPosition, humanoid.RootPart.Position, config.meleeMinCloseDist) or lastSeenPosition + lostSightRadius, 1)
				else
					moveTo(onSight and lastSeenPosition or lastSeenPosition + lostSightRadius, 1)
				end
			end
			while states.coverDamage do
				if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and target.Humanoid.Health > 0 and target.Humanoid.RootPart and not isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, states.target.part, params) then
					onSightTick = tick()
				end
				task.wait(config.rate * 2)
			end
			if states.target and target ~= states.target.character then
				target = states.target.character
			end
			
			local waitTime = checkLadder() and humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing and math.max(getDistance(lastSeenPosition, humanoid.RootPart) / 40, 3) or ladderPart and 1 or config.rate
			if waitTime <= config.rate then
				task.wait(config.rate)
			else
				local t = tick()
				while tick() - t < waitTime do
					if getDistance(lastSeenPosition, humanoid.RootPart) <= 1 then
						break
					end
					if states.target.part.Position.y < humanoid.RootPart.Position.y - 5 and not isObstacle(humanoid.RootPart, states.target.part, params) then
						humanoid.Jump = true
						task.wait()
						break
					end
					task.wait(config.rate)
				end
			end
		end
		
		character:SetAttribute("aim", false)
		table.clear(states.target)
		states.target = false
		states.run = false
		return true
	else
		if typeof(states.target) == "table" then
			table.clear(states.target)
		end
		states.target = false
	end
	
	return false
end

local function loadAnim(id)
	local animTrack = Instance.new("Animation")
	animTrack.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	return animator:LoadAnimation(animTrack),
		animTrack:Destroy()
end

local DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {

	TIME_VARIANCE = 0.07;

	COMPARISON_CHECKS = 3;

	JUMP_WHEN_STUCK = false;
}

local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local function output(func, msg)
	func(((func == error and "SimplePath Error: ") or "SimplePath: ")..msg)
end
local Path = {
	StatusType = {
		Idle = "Idle";
		Active = "Active";
	};
	ErrorType = {
		LimitReached = "LimitReached";
		TargetUnreachable = "TargetUnreachable";
		ComputationError = "ComputationError";
		AgentStuck = "AgentStuck";
	};
}
Path.__index = function(table, index)
	if index == "Stopped" and not table._humanoid then
		output(error, "Attempt to use Path.Stopped on a non-humanoid.")
	end
	return (table._events[index] and table._events[index].Event)
		or (index == "LastError" and table._lastError)
		or (index == "Status" and table._status)
		or Path[index]
end

--Used to visualize waypoints
local visualWaypoint = Instance.new("Part")
visualWaypoint.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
visualWaypoint.Anchored = true
visualWaypoint.CanCollide = false
visualWaypoint.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
visualWaypoint.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball

--[[ PRIVATE FUNCTIONS ]]--
local function declareError(self, errorType)
	self._lastError = errorType
	self._events.Error:Fire(errorType)
end

--Create visual waypoints
local function createVisualWaypoints(waypoints)
	local visualWaypoints = {}
	for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
		local visualWaypointClone = visualWaypoint:Clone()
		visualWaypointClone.Position = waypoint.Position
		visualWaypointClone.Parent = workspace
		visualWaypointClone.Color =
			(waypoint == waypoints[#waypoints] and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0))
			or (waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
			or Color3.fromRGB(255, 139, 0)
		table.insert(visualWaypoints, visualWaypointClone)
	end
	return visualWaypoints
end

--Destroy visual waypoints
local function destroyVisualWaypoints(waypoints)
	if waypoints then
		for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
			waypoint:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return
end

--Get initial waypoint for non-humanoid
local function getNonHumanoidWaypoint(self)
	--Account for multiple waypoints that are sometimes in the same place
	for i = 2, #self._waypoints do
		if (self._waypoints[i].Position - self._waypoints[i - 1].Position).Magnitude > 0.1 then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 2
end

--Make NPC jump
local function setJumpState(self)
	pcall(function()
		if self._humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and self._humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
			self._humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		end
	end)
end

--Primary move function
local function move(self)
	if self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint].Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
		setJumpState(self)
	end
	self._humanoid:MoveTo(self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint].Position)
end

--Disconnect MoveToFinished connection when pathfinding ends
local function disconnectMoveConnection(self)
	self._moveConnection:Disconnect()
	self._moveConnection = nil
end

--Fire the WaypointReached event
local function invokeWaypointReached(self)
	local lastWaypoint = self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint - 1]
	local nextWaypoint = self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint]
	self._events.WaypointReached:Fire(self._agent, lastWaypoint, nextWaypoint)
end

local function moveToFinished(self, reached)
	
	--Stop execution if Path is destroyed
	if not getmetatable(self) then return end

	--Handle case for non-humanoids
	if not self._humanoid then
		if reached and self._currentWaypoint + 1 <= #self._waypoints then
			invokeWaypointReached(self)
			self._currentWaypoint += 1
		elseif reached then
			self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
			self._target = nil
			self._events.Reached:Fire(self._agent, self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint])
		else
			self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
			self._target = nil
			declareError(self, self.ErrorType.TargetUnreachable)
		end
		return
	end

	if reached and self._currentWaypoint + 1 <= #self._waypoints  then --Waypoint reached
		if self._currentWaypoint + 1 < #self._waypoints then
			invokeWaypointReached(self)
		end
		self._currentWaypoint += 1
		move(self)
	elseif reached then --Target reached, pathfinding ends
		disconnectMoveConnection(self)
		self._status = Path.StatusType.Idle
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
		self._events.Reached:Fire(self._agent, self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint])
	else --Target unreachable
		disconnectMoveConnection(self)
		self._status = Path.StatusType.Idle
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
		declareError(self, self.ErrorType.TargetUnreachable)
	end
end

--Refer to Settings.COMPARISON_CHECKS
local function comparePosition(self)
	if self._currentWaypoint == #self._waypoints then return end
	self._position._count = ((self._agent.PrimaryPart.Position - self._position._last).Magnitude <= 0.07 and (self._position._count + 1)) or 0
	self._position._last = self._agent.PrimaryPart.Position
	if self._position._count >= self._settings.COMPARISON_CHECKS then
		if self._settings.JUMP_WHEN_STUCK then
			setJumpState(self)
		end
		declareError(self, self.ErrorType.AgentStuck)
	end
end

--[[ STATIC METHODS ]]--
function Path.GetNearestCharacter(fromPosition)
	local character, dist = nil, math.huge
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character and (player.Character.PrimaryPart.Position - fromPosition).Magnitude < dist then
			character, dist = player.Character, (player.Character.PrimaryPart.Position - fromPosition).Magnitude
		end
	end
	return character
end

--[[ CONSTRUCTOR ]]--
function Path.new(agent, agentParameters, override)
	if not (agent and agent:IsA("Model") and agent.PrimaryPart) then
		output(error, "Pathfinding agent must be a valid Model Instance with a set PrimaryPart.")
	end

	local self = setmetatable({
		_settings = override or DEFAULT_SETTINGS;
		_events = {
			Reached = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
			WaypointReached = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
			Blocked = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
			Error = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
			Stopped = Instance.new("BindableEvent");
		};
		_agent = agent;
		_humanoid = agent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
		_path = PathfindingService:CreatePath(agentParameters);
		_status = "Idle";
		_t = 0;
		_position = {
			_last = Vector3.new();
			_count = 0;
		};
	}, Path)

	--Configure settings
	for setting, value in pairs(DEFAULT_SETTINGS) do
		self._settings[setting] = self._settings[setting] == nil and value or self._settings[setting]
	end

	--Path blocked connection
	self._path.Blocked:Connect(function(...)
		if (self._currentWaypoint <= ... and self._currentWaypoint + 1 >= ...) and self._humanoid then
			setJumpState(self)
			self._events.Blocked:Fire(self._agent, self._waypoints[...])
		end
	end)

	return self
end


--[[ NON-STATIC METHODS ]]--
function Path:Destroy()
	for _, event in ipairs(self._events) do
		event:Destroy()
	end
	self._events = nil
	if rawget(self, "_visualWaypoints") then
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
	end
	self._path:Destroy()
	setmetatable(self, nil)
	for k, _ in pairs(self) do
		self[k] = nil
	end
end

function Path:Stop()
	if not self._humanoid then
		output(error, "Attempt to call Path:Stop() on a non-humanoid.")
		return
	end
	if self._status == Path.StatusType.Idle then
		output(function(m)
			warn(debug.traceback(m))
		end, "Attempt to run Path:Stop() in idle state")
		return
	end
	disconnectMoveConnection(self)
	self._status = Path.StatusType.Idle
	self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
	self._events.Stopped:Fire(self._model)
end

function Path:Run(target)

	--Non-humanoid handle case
	if not target and not self._humanoid and self._target then
		moveToFinished(self, true)
		return
	end

	--Parameter check
	if not (target and (typeof(target) == "Vector3" or target:IsA("BasePart"))) then
		output(error, "Pathfinding target must be a valid Vector3 or BasePart.")
	end

	--Refer to Settings.TIME_VARIANCE
	if os.clock() - self._t <= self._settings.TIME_VARIANCE and self._humanoid then
		task.wait(os.clock() - self._t)
		declareError(self, self.ErrorType.LimitReached)
		return false
	elseif self._humanoid then
		self._t = os.clock()
	end

	--Compute path
	local pathComputed, _ = pcall(function()
		self._path:ComputeAsync(self._agent.PrimaryPart.Position, (typeof(target) == "Vector3" and target) or target.Position)
	end)

	--Make sure path computation is successful
	if not pathComputed
		or self._path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.NoPath
		or #self._path:GetWaypoints() < 2
		or (self._humanoid and self._humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall) then
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
		task.wait()
		declareError(self, self.ErrorType.ComputationError)
		return false
	end

	--Set status to active; pathfinding starts
	self._status = (self._humanoid and Path.StatusType.Active) or Path.StatusType.Idle
	self._target = target

	--Set network owner to server to prevent "hops"
	pcall(function()
		self._agent.PrimaryPart:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end)

	--Initialize waypoints
	self._waypoints = self._path:GetWaypoints()
	self._currentWaypoint = 2

	--Refer to Settings.COMPARISON_CHECKS
	if self._humanoid then
		comparePosition(self)
	end

	--Visualize waypoints
	destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
	self._visualWaypoints = (self.Visualize and createVisualWaypoints(self._waypoints))

	--Create a new move connection if it doesn't exist already
	self._moveConnection = self._humanoid and (self._moveConnection or self._humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function(...)
		moveToFinished(self, ...)
	end))

	--Begin pathfinding
	if self._humanoid then
		self._humanoid:MoveTo(self._waypoints[self._currentWaypoint].Position)
	elseif #self._waypoints == 2 then
		self._target = nil
		self._visualWaypoints = destroyVisualWaypoints(self._visualWaypoints)
		self._events.Reached:Fire(self._agent, self._waypoints[2])
	else
		self._currentWaypoint = getNonHumanoidWaypoint(self)
		moveToFinished(self, true)
	end
	return true
end

return Path

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local module = {}

function module:debugLine(p1, p2, dur, color1, color2, line_color)
	local a = Storage.Miscs.debugObjects.A:Clone()
	local b = Storage.Miscs.debugObjects.B:Clone()
	a.Color = color1 or a.Color
	b.Color = color2 or b.Color
	a.Beam.Color = line_color and ColorSequence.new(line_color) or a.Beam.Color
	a.Beam.Attachment0 = a.Attachment
	a.Beam.Attachment1 = b.Attachment
	a.Position = p1
	b.Position = p1 + p2
	a.Parent = workspace.Ignored
	b.Parent = workspace.Ignored
	Debris:AddItem(a, dur or 3)
	Debris:AddItem(b, dur or 3)
end

function module:point(p1, dur)
	local p = Storage.Miscs.debugObjects.Point:Clone()
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(p1)
	p.Parent = workspace.Ignored
	Debris:AddItem(p, dur or 3)
end

return module

-- Setup Animation Objects
local currentAnim = ""
local currentAnimInstance = nil
local currentTrack = nil
local animTracks = {}
local animator = Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

-- Helper to load animation
local function loadAnim(animName)
	local data = animTable[animName]
	if not data then return nil end

	-- Pick weighted random animation (standard behavior)
	local totalWeight = 0
	for _, entry in pairs(data) do totalWeight = totalWeight + entry.weight end
	local randomWeight = math.random(0, totalWeight)
	local selectedId = data[1].id

	local currentWeight = 0
	for _, entry in pairs(data) do
		currentWeight = currentWeight + entry.weight
		if randomWeight <= currentWeight then
			selectedId = entry.id
			break
		end
	end

	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = selectedId
	anim.Name = animName
	return anim
end

local function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	local anim = loadAnim(animName)
	if not anim then return end

	if currentTrack then
		currentTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
		currentTrack:Destroy()
	end

	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
	track:Play(transitionTime)
	currentTrack = track
	currentAnim = animName
end

local function stopAllAnimations()
	local tracks = animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
	for _,track in pairs(tracks) do
		track:Stop(0)
		track:Destroy()
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while Character.Parent do
		local poseNow = "Idle"
		local state = Humanoid:GetState()
		local speed = Humanoid.RootPart.Velocity.Magnitude

		if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
			poseNow = "Jump"
		elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
			poseNow = "Fall"
		elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
			poseNow = "Climb"
		elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
			poseNow = "Sit"
		elseif speed > 12 then
			poseNow = "Run"
		elseif speed > 1 then
			poseNow = "Walk"
		else
			poseNow = "Idle"
		end

		-- Override with Tool Animation if equipped
		if toolAnim ~= "None" then
			if poseNow == "Idle" then
				poseNow = toolAnim
			end
		end

		if currentAnim ~= poseNow then
			playAnimation(poseNow, 0.2, Humanoid)
		end

		-- Adjust Speed for Movement
		if currentTrack then
			if poseNow == "Walk" then
				currentTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed / 8) -- Standard WalkSpeed divisor
			elseif poseNow == "Run" then
				currentTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed / 16)
			end
		end

		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)

CLASS_NAME: Script

-- Created by Quenty (@Quenty, follow me on twitter).
-- Should work with only ONE copy, seamlessly with weapons, trains, et cetera.
-- Parts should be ANCHORED before use. It will, however, store relatives values and so when tools are reparented, it'll fix them.

--[[ INSTRUCTIONS
- Place in the model
- Make sure model is anchored
- That's it. It will weld the model and all children. 

THIS SCRIPT SHOULD BE USED ONLY BY ITSELF. THE MODEL SHOULD BE ANCHORED. 
THIS SCRIPT SHOULD BE USED ONLY BY ITSELF. THE MODEL SHOULD BE ANCHORED. 
THIS SCRIPT SHOULD BE USED ONLY BY ITSELF. THE MODEL SHOULD BE ANCHORED. 
THIS SCRIPT SHOULD BE USED ONLY BY ITSELF. THE MODEL SHOULD BE ANCHORED. 
THIS SCRIPT SHOULD BE USED ONLY BY ITSELF. THE MODEL SHOULD BE ANCHORED. 
THIS SCRIPT SHOULD BE USED ONLY BY ITSELF. THE MODEL SHOULD BE ANCHORED. 
THIS SCRIPT SHOULD BE USED ONLY BY ITSELF. THE MODEL SHOULD BE ANCHORED. 
THIS SCRIPT SHOULD BE USED ONLY BY ITSELF. THE MODEL SHOULD BE ANCHORED. 

This script is designed to be used is a regular script. In a local script it will weld, but it will not attempt to handle ancestory changes. 
]]

--[[ DOCUMENTATION
- Will work in tools. If ran more than once it will not create more than one weld.  This is especially useful for tools that are dropped and then picked up again.
- Will work in PBS servers
- Will work as long as it starts out with the part anchored
- Stores the relative CFrame as a CFrame value
- Takes careful measure to reduce lag by not having a joint set off or affected by the parts offset from origin
- Utilizes a recursive algorith to find all parts in the model
- Will reweld on script reparent if the script is initially parented to a tool.
- Welds as fast as possible
]]

-- qPerfectionWeld.lua
-- Created 10/6/2014
-- Author: Quenty
-- Version 1.0.3

-- Updated 10/14/2014 - Updated to 1.0.1
--- Bug fix with existing ROBLOX welds ? Repro by asimo3089

-- Updated 10/14/2014 - Updated to 1.0.2
--- Fixed bug fix. 

-- Updated 10/14/2014 - Updated to 1.0.3
--- Now handles joints semi-acceptably. May be rather hacky with some joints. :/

local NEVER_BREAK_JOINTS = false -- If you set this to true it will never break joints (this can create some welding issues, but can save stuff like hinges).


local function CallOnChildren(Instance, FunctionToCall)
	-- Calls a function on each of the children of a certain object, using recursion.  

	FunctionToCall(Instance)

	for _, Child in next, Instance:GetChildren() do
		CallOnChildren(Child, FunctionToCall)
	end
end

local function GetNearestParent(Instance, ClassName)
	-- Returns the nearest parent of a certain class, or returns nil

	local Ancestor = Instance
	repeat
		Ancestor = Ancestor.Parent
		if Ancestor == nil then
			return nil
		end
	until Ancestor:IsA(ClassName)

	return Ancestor
end

local function GetBricks(StartInstance)
	local List = {}

	-- if StartInstance:IsA("BasePart") then
	-- 	List[#List+1] = StartInstance
	-- end

	CallOnChildren(StartInstance, function(Item)
		if Item:IsA("BasePart") then
			List[#List+1] = Item;
		end
	end)

	return List
end

local function Modify(Instance, Values)
	-- Modifies an Instance by using a table.  

	assert(type(Values) == "table", "Values is not a table");

	for Index, Value in next, Values do
		if type(Index) == "number" then
			Value.Parent = Instance
		else
			Instance[Index] = Value
		end
	end
	return Instance
end

local function Make(ClassType, Properties)
	-- Using a syntax hack to create a nice way to Make new items.  

	return Modify(Instance.new(ClassType), Properties)
end

local Surfaces = {"TopSurface", "BottomSurface", "LeftSurface", "RightSurface", "FrontSurface", "BackSurface"}
local HingSurfaces = {"Hinge", "Motor", "SteppingMotor"}

local function HasWheelJoint(Part)
	for _, SurfaceName in pairs(Surfaces) do
		for _, HingSurfaceName in pairs(HingSurfaces) do
			if Part[SurfaceName].Name == HingSurfaceName then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	
	return false
end

local function ShouldBreakJoints(Part)
	--- We do not want to break joints of wheels/hinges. This takes the utmost care to not do this. There are
	--  definitely some edge cases. 

	if NEVER_BREAK_JOINTS then
		return false
	end
	
	if HasWheelJoint(Part) then
		return false
	end
	
	local Connected = Part:GetConnectedParts()
	
	if #Connected == 1 then
		return false
	end
	
	for _, Item in pairs(Connected) do
		if HasWheelJoint(Item) then
			return false
		elseif not Item:IsDescendantOf(script.Parent) then
			return false
		end
	end
	
	return true
end

local function WeldTogether(Part0, Part1, JointType, WeldParent)
	--- Weld's 2 parts together
	-- @param Part0 The first part
	-- @param Part1 The second part (Dependent part most of the time).
	-- @param [JointType] The type of joint. Defaults to weld.
	-- @param [WeldParent] Parent of the weld, Defaults to Part0 (so GC is better).
	-- @return The weld created.

	JointType = JointType or "Weld"
	local RelativeValue = Part1:FindFirstChild("qRelativeCFrameWeldValue")
	
	local NewWeld = Part1:FindFirstChild("qCFrameWeldThingy") or Instance.new(JointType)
	Modify(NewWeld, {
		Name = "qCFrameWeldThingy";
		Part0  = Part0;
		Part1  = Part1;
		C0     = CFrame.new();--Part0.CFrame:inverse();
		C1     = RelativeValue and RelativeValue.Value or Part1.CFrame:toObjectSpace(Part0.CFrame); --Part1.CFrame:inverse() * Part0.CFrame;-- Part1.CFrame:inverse();
		Parent = Part1;
	})

	if not RelativeValue then
		RelativeValue = Make("CFrameValue", {
			Parent     = Part1;
			Name       = "qRelativeCFrameWeldValue";
			Archivable = true;
			Value      = NewWeld.C1;
		})
	end

	return NewWeld
end

local function WeldParts(Parts, MainPart, JointType, DoNotUnanchor)
	-- @param Parts The Parts to weld. Should be anchored to prevent really horrible results.
	-- @param MainPart The part to weld the model to (can be in the model).
	-- @param [JointType] The type of joint. Defaults to weld. 
	-- @parm DoNotUnanchor Boolean, if true, will not unachor the model after cmopletion.
	
	for _, Part in pairs(Parts) do
		if ShouldBreakJoints(Part) then
			Part:BreakJoints()
		end
	end
	
	for _, Part in pairs(Parts) do
		if Part ~= MainPart then
			WeldTogether(MainPart, Part, JointType, MainPart)
		end
	end

	if not DoNotUnanchor then
		for _, Part in pairs(Parts) do
			Part.Anchored = false
		end
		MainPart.Anchored = false
	end
end

local function PerfectionWeld()	
	local Tool = GetNearestParent(script, "Tool")

	local Parts = GetBricks(script.Parent)
	local PrimaryPart = Tool and Tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") and Tool.Handle:IsA("BasePart") and Tool.Handle or script.Parent:IsA("Model") and script.Parent.PrimaryPart or Parts[1]

	if PrimaryPart then
		WeldParts(Parts, PrimaryPart, "Weld", false)
	else
		warn("qWeld - Unable to weld part")
	end
	
	return Tool
end

local Tool = PerfectionWeld()


if Tool and script.ClassName == "Script" then
	--- Don't bother with local scripts

	script.Parent.AncestryChanged:connect(function()
		PerfectionWeld()
	end)
end

FILE_END: ServerStorage.Contents.Mossberg 500.Bolt.qPerfectionWeld

FILE_START: ServerStorage.Contents..Animate
CLASS_NAME: LocalScript
----------------------------------------------------------------
local Character = script.Parent

-- Setup Animation Objects
local currentAnim = ""
local currentAnimInstance = nil
local currentTrack = nil
local animTracks = {}
local animator = Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

-- Helper to load animation
local function loadAnim(animName)
	local data = animTable[animName]
	if not data then return nil end

	-- Pick weighted random animation (standard behavior)
	local totalWeight = 0
	for _, entry in pairs(data) do totalWeight = totalWeight + entry.weight end
	local randomWeight = math.random(0, totalWeight)
	local selectedId = data[1].id

	local currentWeight = 0
	for _, entry in pairs(data) do
		currentWeight = currentWeight + entry.weight
		if randomWeight <= currentWeight then
			selectedId = entry.id
			break
		end
	end

	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = selectedId
	anim.Name = animName
	return anim
end

local function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	local anim = loadAnim(animName)
	if not anim then return end

	if currentTrack then
		currentTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
		currentTrack:Destroy()
	end

	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
	track:Play(transitionTime)
	currentTrack = track
	currentAnim = animName
end

local function stopAllAnimations()
	local tracks = animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
	for _,track in pairs(tracks) do
		track:Stop(0)
		track:Destroy()
	end
end

-- Tool Handling
local toolAnim = "None"
local toolAnimTime = 0

local function onToolEquipped(tool)
	toolAnim = "toolnone"
	toolAnimTime = 0
end

local function onToolUnequipped()
	toolAnim = "None"
	toolAnimTime = 0
end

Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child:IsA("Tool") then
		onToolEquipped(child)
	end
end)

Character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
	if child:IsA("Tool") then
		onToolUnequipped()
	end
end)

-- Main Loop
task.spawn(function()
	while Character.Parent do
		local poseNow = "Idle"
		local state = Humanoid:GetState()
		local speed = Humanoid.RootPart.Velocity.Magnitude

		if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
			poseNow = "Jump"
		elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
			poseNow = "Fall"
		elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
			poseNow = "Climb"
		elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
			poseNow = "Sit"
		elseif speed > 12 then
			poseNow = "Run"
		elseif speed > 1 then
			poseNow = "Walk"
		else
			poseNow = "Idle"
		end

		-- Override with Tool Animation if equipped
		if toolAnim ~= "None" then
			if poseNow == "Idle" then
				poseNow = toolAnim
			end
		end

		if currentAnim ~= poseNow then
			playAnimation(poseNow, 0.2, Humanoid)
		end

		-- Adjust Speed for Movement
		if currentTrack then
			if poseNow == "Walk" then
				currentTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed / 8) -- Standard WalkSpeed divisor
			elseif poseNow == "Run" then
				currentTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed / 16)
			end
		end

		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local Ragdoll = {}

-- [R15 FIX] Joint Mapping
local R15_JOINTS = {
	{"Neck", "Head", "UpperTorso"},
	{"Waist", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso"},
	{"LeftShoulder", "LeftUpperArm", "UpperTorso"},
	{"RightShoulder", "RightUpperArm", "UpperTorso"},
	{"LeftHip", "LeftUpperLeg", "LowerTorso"},
	{"RightHip", "RightUpperLeg", "LowerTorso"},
	{"LeftElbow", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftUpperArm"},
	{"RightElbow", "RightLowerArm", "RightUpperArm"},
	{"LeftKnee", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftUpperLeg"},
	{"RightKnee", "RightLowerLeg", "RightUpperLeg"},
	{"LeftAnkle", "LeftFoot", "LeftLowerLeg"},
	{"RightAnkle", "RightFoot", "RightLowerLeg"}
}

function Ragdoll.create(character)
	if character:FindFirstChild("RagdollConstraints") then return end

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "RagdollConstraints"
	folder.Parent = character

	for _, j in ipairs(R15_JOINTS) do
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(j[2])
		local parent = character:FindFirstChild(j[3])

		if part and parent then
			local att0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
			att0.Name = "RagdollAtt"
			att0.Parent = parent

			local att1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
			att1.Name = "RagdollAtt"
			att1.Parent = part

			-- Try to align with existing Motor6D if found
			local motor = part:FindFirstChild(j[1]) or parent:FindFirstChild(j[1])
			if motor then
				att0.CFrame = motor.C0
				att1.CFrame = motor.C1
			end

			local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
			socket.Attachment0 = att0
			socket.Attachment1 = att1
			socket.Enabled = false
			socket.Parent = folder
			socket.Name = "Constraint_" .. j[1]
		end
	end
end

function Ragdoll.setGlobal(character, type, state, velocityPart, duration)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end

	if state then
		-- ENABLE
		Ragdoll.create(character)
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false

		for _, v in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("Motor6D") then
				if v.Name ~= "Root" then v.Enabled = false end
			elseif v:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
				v.Enabled = true
			end
		end

		if velocityPart then
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local vel = typeof(velocityPart) == "Instance" and velocityPart.Velocity or velocityPart
				root.Velocity = vel
			end
		end

		if duration and duration > 0 then
			task.delay(duration, function()
				Ragdoll.setGlobal(character, type, false)
			end)
		end
	else
		-- DISABLE (Recover)
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true

		for _, v in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("Motor6D") then
				v.Enabled = true
			elseif v:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
				v.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end
end

return Ragdoll

FILE_START: ServerStorage.Storage.Modules.Ragdoll.LocalScript
CLASS_NAME: LocalScript

local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
humanoid:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ragdoll"):Connect(function()
	local state = humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")
	if humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = not state
	else
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	end
	if (state) then
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall, false)
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics, false)
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	else
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
		local connection
		connection = humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,current)
			if (current == Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp or humanoid.Health < 1) then
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall, true)
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics, true)
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
		end)
	end
end)

local module = {}
module.__index = module

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Assets = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Storage")

local limbsToMotor = {
	["Head"] = "Neck",
	["Right Arm"] = "Right Shoulder",
	["Right Leg"] = "Right Hip",
	["Left Arm"] = "Left Shoulder",
	["Left Leg"] = "Left Hip",
}

local motorToLimbs = {
	["Neck"] = "Neck",
	["Right Shoulder"] = "Right Arm",
	["Right Hip"] = "Right Leg",
	["Left Shoulder"] = "Left Arm",
	["Left Hip"] = "Left Leg",
}

local config = {
	debug = false;
}

local euphoriaAnims = {
	["Normal"] = {
		15517367813,
	};
	["Arm"] = {
		["Left Arm"] = {
			15517370023,
			15517371415
		},
		["Right Arm"] = {
			15517372859,
			15517374288
		},
	};
	["Head"] = {
		15517376027,
		15517379672,
		15517380831,
		15517382183,
		15517383464
	};
	["Leg"] = {
		["Right Leg"] = {
			15517384430,
		},
		["Left Leg"] = {
			15517385564,
		}
	};
}

function module.create(character, euphoria)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
	task.delay(1 / 30, function()
		local clientScript = player and script.LocalScript:Clone()
		if player then
			clientScript.Parent = player.PlayerGui
			clientScript.Enabled = true
		end
	end)
	local ragdollStuff = {}
	local collisions = {}
	local muscles = euphoria and Assets.Ragdoll.Muscles.Bones:Clone()
	local musclesSprings = {}
	local euphoriaState = false
	if (muscles) then
		local connection
		connection = character.Destroying:Connect(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
			muscles:Destroy()
		end)
		muscles.Name = character.Name .. "__muscles"
		muscles.Parent = workspace.Ignored.Muscles
		muscles.Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
		weld.Part0 = character.Torso
		weld.Part1 = muscles.Torso
		weld.Parent = character
		if (config.debug) then
			for _,part in pairs(muscles:GetDescendants()) do
				if (part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= muscles.Humanoid.RootPart) then
					part.Transparency = 0.75
				elseif (part:IsA("Attachment")) then
					part.Visible = true
				elseif (part:IsA("Beam")) then
					part.Enabled = true
				end
			end
		end
		
		for _,bone in pairs(muscles:GetDescendants()) do
			if (bone:IsA("Attachment")) then
				local charBone = character:FindFirstChild(bone.Name, true)
				if (charBone) then
					local spring = Instance.new("SpringConstraint")
					spring.Attachment0 = bone
					spring.Attachment1 = charBone
					spring.LimitsEnabled = true
					spring.MaxLength = bone.Length.Value
					spring.Enabled = false
					spring.Name = bone.Parent.Name
					spring.Parent = bone.Parent
					musclesSprings[#musclesSprings + 1] = spring
					
					local bone2 = bone.Parent:FindFirstChild(bone.Name .. "1")
					if (bone2) then
						local a0 = bone2:Clone()
						a0.Parent = charBone.Parent
						local spring = Instance.new("SpringConstraint")
						spring.Attachment0 = a0
						spring.Attachment1 = bone.Parent[bone.Name .. "1"]
						spring.LimitsEnabled = true
						spring.MaxLength = bone2.Length.Value
						spring.Enabled = false
						spring.Name = bone.Parent.Name
						spring.Parent = bone.Parent
						musclesSprings[#musclesSprings + 1] = spring
					end
				end
			end
		end
		
		--humanoid.RootPart:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end
	for _,part in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		local validPart = Assets.Ragdoll:FindFirstChild(part.Name)
		if (validPart) then
			part.CanCollide = false
			local a0, a1 = validPart["0"]:Clone(), validPart["1"]:Clone()
			local socket = validPart.Socket:Clone()
			socket.Attachment0 = a0
			socket.Attachment1 = a1
			socket.Parent = part
			a0.Parent = character.Torso
			a1.Parent = part
			a0.Name = "_RD"
			a1.Name = "_RD"
			ragdollStuff[#ragdollStuff + 1] = a0
			ragdollStuff[#ragdollStuff + 1] = a1
			ragdollStuff[#ragdollStuff + 1] = socket
			
			local collisionPart = validPart.collision:Clone()
			collisionPart.Weld.Part0 = part
			collisionPart.Name = part.Name
			collisionPart.CollisionGroup = "Debris"
			collisionPart.CanCollide = false
			collisionPart.Parent = part
			collisions[#collisions + 1] = collisionPart
		end
	end
	
	local event = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	local connections = {}
	local forces = {}
	
	table.insert(connections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		event:Fire("switch", true, euphoriaState)
	end))
	
	humanoid:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", false)
	local function charFunc(type, ...)
		if (type == "clean") then
			for index,con in pairs(connections) do
				con:Disconnect()
				connections[index] = nil
			end
			for index,stuff in pairs(ragdollStuff) do
				stuff:Destroy()
				ragdollStuff[index] = nil
			end
			event:Destroy()
		elseif (type == "switch") then
			local boolean, euphoria, part = ...
			if (character:FindFirstChild("Torso")) then
				humanoid:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", boolean)
				local noMess = {}
				for _,motor in pairs(character.Torso:GetChildren()) do
					if (motor:IsA("Motor6D") and not motor:FindFirstChild("no")) then
						motor.Enabled = not boolean
					elseif (motor:FindFirstChild("no")) then
						noMess[motor.Name] = true
					end
				end
				
				if (boolean and euphoria) then
					for _,socket in pairs(ragdollStuff) do
						if (socket:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") and socket.Parent.Name ~= "Head" --[[and socket.Parent ~= part]]) then
							socket.Enabled = false
						end
					end
				else
					for _,socket in pairs(ragdollStuff) do
						if (socket:IsA("BallSocketConstraint")) then
							socket.Enabled = true
						end
					end
				end
				
				for _,part in pairs(collisions) do
					if (not noMess[part.Name]) then
						part.CanCollide = boolean
					end
				end
				
				-- // ragdoll state
				if (not player) then
					if (boolean) then

									force.Force = Vector3.new(0, part:GetMass() * 50, 0)
									force.Parent = part
									forces[#forces + 1] = force
								end
							end
						end

						humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
						humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall, false)
						humanoid.PlatformStand = true
					else
						for index,force in pairs(forces) do
							force:Destroy()
							forces[index] = nil
						end
						forces = {}
						humanoid.PlatformStand = false
						humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
						local connection
						connection = humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,current)
							if (current == Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp or humanoid.Health < 1) then
								humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
								humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
								humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall, true)
								connection:Disconnect()
							end
						end)
					end
				end
				
				--humanoid.RootPart:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
				if not boolean then
					humanoid:SetAttribute("RagdollDur", 0)
				end
			end
		elseif (type == "muscles") then
			local state, part, disableTime, playTime = ...
			for _,spring in pairs(musclesSprings) do
				--[[if ((state and spring.Name ~= part.Name) or humanoid.Health <= 0) then
					spring.Enabled = true
				else
					task.delay(disableTime or 16e-6, function()
						spring.Enabled = false
					end)
				end]]
				
				if (state or humanoid.Health <= 0) then
					spring.Enabled = true
				else
					task.delay(disableTime or 16e-6, function()
						spring.Enabled = false
					end)
				end
			end
			euphoriaState = state
			event:Fire("switch", (state or humanoid.Health <= 0), true, part)
			if (state) then
				for _,anim in pairs(muscles.Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
					anim:Stop()
				end
				local animId
				for index,t in pairs(euphoriaAnims) do
					if (string.find(part.Name, index)) then
						animId = t[part.Name] and t[part.Name][math.random(#t[part.Name])] or t[math.random(#t)]	
						break
					else
						animId = euphoriaAnims.Normal[math.random(#euphoriaAnims.Normal)]
					end
				end
				local animTrack = Instance.new("Animation")
				animTrack.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. animId
				local anim = muscles.Humanoid.Animator:LoadAnimation(animTrack)
				anim:Play()
				anim:AdjustWeight(math.random(8, 10) / 10)
				animTrack:Destroy()
				task.spawn(function()
					local startTick = tick()
					while euphoriaState and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and tick() - startTick < playTime - 0.5 do
						task.wait(1 / 30)
					end
					anim:AdjustWeight(0, playTime - 0.5)
				end)
			else
				for _,anim in pairs(muscles.Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
					anim:Stop(0.5)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	table.insert(connections, event.Event:Connect(function(...)
		charFunc(...)
	end))
	
	return setmetatable({
		character = character,
		humanoid = humanoid,
		event = event,
		ragdoll = false,
		euphoria = false,
		dur = 0,
		connections = connections
	}, module)
end

function module.setGlobal(...)
	script._signal:Fire(...)
end

function module:registerEvent()
	table.insert(self.connections, script._signal.Event:Connect(function(char, func, ...)
		if (char == self.character) then
			if (func == "set") then
				self:set(...)
			elseif (func == "setLimb") then
				self:setLimb(...)
			elseif (func == "muscles") then
				self:muscles(func, ...)
			end
		end
	end))
end

function module:getTime()
	return tick() - self.dur
end

function module:set(state, timer)
	if (state) then
		self.dur = os.clock()
		timer = self.humanoid:GetAttribute("RagdollDur") > 0 and self.humanoid:GetAttribute("RagdollDur") or nil
	else
		self.ragdoll = false
		return
	end

	if (not self.ragdoll) then
		self.ragdoll = true
		self.event:Fire("switch", true, self.euphoria)

		task.spawn(function()
			while self.character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and self.humanoid.Health > 0 and self:getTime() < (timer or math.huge) and self.ragdoll do
				task.wait(1 / 30)
			end

			if (self.humanoid.Health > 0 and not self.euphoria) then
				self.ragdoll = false
				if (self.character:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
					self.event:Fire("switch", false, self.euphoria)
				else
					self:destroy()
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function module:setLimb(limb, state)
	local motor = self.character.Torso[limbsToMotor[limb]]
	motor.Enabled = state
	if (not state and not motor:FindFirstChild("no")) then
		local no = Instance.new("StringValue")
		no.Name = "no"
		no.Parent = motor
	elseif (state) then
		local findMotor = motor:FindFirstChild("no")
		if (findMotor) then findMotor:Destroy() end
	end
end

function module:muscles(func, state, ...)
	self.euphoria = state
	self.event:Fire(func, state, ...)
end

function module:destroy()
	--self.character:Destroy()
	self.event:Fire("clean")
	for index,_ in pairs(self) do
		self[index] = nil
	end
end

function module:Destroy()
	return self:destroy()
end

return module

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local Storage = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Storage")

local CharacterEffects = require(Storage.Modules.CharacterEffects)

local module = {}
function module:createEffects(humanoid)
	for name,data in pairs(CharacterEffects) do
		humanoid:SetAttribute(name, false)
		for attributeName,attributeValue in pairs(data.attributes) do
			humanoid:SetAttribute(attributeName, attributeValue)
		end
		local particles = {}
		particles.burning = {}
		
		humanoid:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
			local state = humanoid:GetAttribute(name)
			if state then
				if name == "Burning" then
					for _,v in pairs(humanoid.Parent:GetChildren()) do
						if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
							for _,p in pairs(Storage.Particles.BurningEffect:GetChildren()) do
								local n = p:Clone()
								n.Enabled = true
								n.Parent = v
								particles.burning[#particles.burning + 1] = n
							end
						end
					end
				end
			else
				if name == "Burning" then
					for i,v in pairs(particles.burning) do
						v.Enabled = false
						Debris:AddItem(v, 3)
						particles.burning[i] = nil
					end
					
					humanoid:SetAttribute("BurnCount", 0)
				end
			end
		end)
		
		local connection
		connection = humanoid.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_,parent)
			if parent == nil then
				connection:Disconnect()
				table.clear(particles)
			end
		end)
	end
end

return module

local function deepCopy(original)
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in pairs(original) do
		if type(v) == "table" then
			v = deepCopy(v)
		end
		copy[k] = v
	end

	return copy
end

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Storage = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Storage")
local StorageServer = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Storage")

local Ragdoll = require(StorageServer.Modules.Ragdoll)
local Network = require(Storage.Modules.Network)

local function deepCopy(original)
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in pairs(original) do
		if type(v) == "table" then
			v = deepCopy(v)
		end
		copy[k] = v
	end

	return copy
end

return function(result, target, character, humanoid, tool, settings, hitPart, dirV3, sessionProfile, finisher)
	if finisher then
		local damage = target.Humanoid.MaxHealth + 50
		target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
		
		if target.Humanoid.RootPart then
			local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
			force.Velocity = (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.UpVector / 2) * 30
			force.Parent = target.Humanoid.RootPart
			Debris:AddItem(force, 0.1)
		end
		
		if target:FindFirstChild("Head") then
			local gib,_ = _G.getGibFromPosition(hitPart, result.Position)
			Network:FireAllClients("client", "gore", target, hitPart, damage, gib, dirV3, result.Position, target.Head.CFrame.LookVector, result.Normal, false)
		end
	elseif target.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
		local knock = settings.knock and hitPart.Name == settings.knockPart
		if knock and sessionProfile.finish.Value == false and math.random(4) == 1 then
			local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
			force.Velocity = (dirV3.unit + (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.UpVector / 2)) * 5
			force.Parent = hitPart
			Debris:AddItem(force, settings.knockFlingTime)

			Ragdoll.setGlobal(target, "muscles", true, hitPart, nil, settings.knockTime)
			task.wait(settings.knockTime)
			if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				Ragdoll.setGlobal(target, "muscles", false, nil, 16e-5)
			end
		end
	end
end

FILE_START: ServerStorage.Storage.Modules.Finisher.Normal.The Crucible
CLASS_NAME: ModuleScript
----------------------------------------------------------------
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Storage = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Storage")
local StorageServer = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Storage")

local Ragdoll = require(StorageServer.Modules.Ragdoll)
local Network = require(Storage.Modules.Network)

local function deepCopy(original)
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in pairs(original) do
		if type(v) == "table" then
			v = deepCopy(v)
		end
		copy[k] = v
	end

	return copy
end

local function getDistance(p1, p2)
	return ((typeof(p1) == "Instance" and p1.Position or p1) - (typeof(p2) == "Instance" and p2.Position or p2)).magnitude
end

-- Helper to check if a part belongs to the Right Arm chain in R15
local function isRightArm(partName)
	return partName == "RightHand" or partName == "RightLowerArm" or partName == "RightUpperArm" or partName == "Right Arm" -- Kept R6 for safety
end

return function(result, target, character, humanoid, tool, settings, hitPart, dirV3, sessionProfile, finisher)
	if finisher then
		if hitPart:GetAttribute("Enabled") then
			hitPart:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
			local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
			force.Velocity = (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.UpVector / 2) * math.random(25, 35)
			force.Parent = hitPart
			hitPart.RotVelocity = hitPart.Velocity
			Debris:AddItem(force, 0.1)
		end
		local damage = target.Humanoid.MaxHealth + 50
		target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
		
		local sound = _G.createSound(Storage.Miscs.Weapons[tool.Name].Sounds.Lightning, target.Humanoid.RootPart.Position)
		_G.createFlashSFX(sound, 800, 250, 0.15)
		sound:Play()
		Network:FireAllClients("client", "crucibleStrike", hitPart.Position)
		task.spawn(function()
			local targets = _G.explode(hitPart.Position, {
				damage = 5,
				radius = 40,
				forceRagdoll = true
			}, {character = character, weapon = tool.Name .. " Explosion"}, {
				springConfig = {Damping = 1.1},
				dur = 0.8,
				min = 20,
				max = 100,
				strength = 130,

				blur = true,

				maxDist = 150,
			}, "CrucibleExplosionEffect", {target, character})
			
			for _,targetHit in pairs(targets) do
				local sparks = {}
				for _,v in pairs(targetHit:GetChildren()) do
					if v.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and v:IsA("BasePart") and v:GetAttribute("Enabled") then
						local spark = Storage.Particles.CrucibleSparks:Clone()
						spark.Parent = v
						sparks[#sparks + 1] = spark
						task.delay(2.5, function()
							spark.Enabled = false
						end)
					end
				end

				task.delay(4, function()
					for _,v in pairs(sparks) do
						v:Destroy()
					end
					table.clear(sparks)
				end)
				
				if targetHit.Humanoid.RootPart then
					Network:FireAllClients("client", "crucibleStrike", targetHit.Humanoid.RootPart.Position, hitPart.Position)
					Network:FireAllClients("client", "crucibleStrike", targetHit.Humanoid.RootPart.Position)
					_G.emitParticle("CrucibleHitEffect", nil, targetHit.Humanoid.RootPart.Position)
				end
			end
			
			table.clear(targets)
		end)
		
		local sparks = {}
		for _,v in pairs(target:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and v:IsA("BasePart") and v:GetAttribute("Enabled") then
				local spark = Storage.Particles.CrucibleSparks:Clone()
				spark.Parent = v
				sparks[#sparks + 1] = spark
				task.delay(2.5, function()
					spark.Enabled = false
				end)
			end
		end
		
		task.delay(4, function()
			for _,v in pairs(sparks) do
				v:Destroy()
			end
			table.clear(sparks)
		end)
		
		if target:FindFirstChild("Head") then
			local gib,_ = _G.getGibFromPosition(hitPart, result.Position)
			Network:FireAllClients("client", "gore", target, hitPart, damage, gib, dirV3, result.Position, target.Head.CFrame.LookVector, result.Normal, false)
		end
		
		if target.Humanoid.RootPart then
			local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
			force.Velocity = (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.UpVector / 2) * 30
			force.Parent = target.Humanoid.RootPart
			Debris:AddItem(force, 0.1)
		end
	else
		if sessionProfile and sessionProfile.finish.Value == false or not character:GetAttribute("finish") then
			
			-- R15 UPDATE: 
			-- Changed `hitPart.Name ~= "Right Arm"` to `not isRightArm(hitPart.Name)`
			-- This prevents the script from accidentally hiding the arm unless the target is dying.
			if not isRightArm(hitPart.Name) or target.Humanoid.Health <= 10 then
				
				-- Safety check: Never disable the RootPart or Torso in this specific non-finisher block
				-- to prevent invisible enemies if the hit detection hits the chest.
				if hitPart.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and hitPart.Name ~= "UpperTorso" and hitPart.Name ~= "LowerTorso" then
					hitPart:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
					hitPart.Velocity = (dirV3.unit + (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.UpVector / 2)) * 60
					hitPart.RotVelocity = hitPart.Velocity / 2
				end
			end
			
			local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
			force.Velocity = (dirV3.unit + (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.UpVector / 2)) * 40
			
			-- R15 Note: target.Head is valid in R15, so this line is fine.
			force.Parent = target:FindFirstChild("Head") and target.Head:GetAttribute("Enabled") and target.Head or target.Humanoid.RootPart
			Debris:AddItem(force, settings.knockFlingTime)

			if target.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				Ragdoll.setGlobal(target, "muscles", true, hitPart, nil, settings.knockTime)
				task.wait(settings.knockTime)
				if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					Ragdoll.setGlobal(target, "muscles", false, nil, 16e-5)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

return function(result, target, character, humanoid, tool, settings, hitPart, dirV3, sessionProfile, finisher)

		local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
		force.Velocity = (dirV3.unit + (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.UpVector / 2)) * 30
		force.Parent = target.Humanoid.RootPart
