			character.Armor[type]:SetAttribute("Equipped", true)
			character.Armor[type]:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", ArmorDatabase[type]["TIER_" .. tier].durability)
			character.Armor[type]:SetAttribute("Health", character.Armor[type]:GetAttribute("MaxHealth"))
			character.Armor[type]:SetAttribute("Tier", tostring(tier))

			for _,v in pairs(Storage.Models.Armors[type]["TIER_" .. tier].Models:GetChildren()) do
				-- R15 Note: Ensure WeldTo.Value points to valid R15 parts (UpperTorso, LeftUpperArm, etc.)
				if character:FindFirstChild(v.WeldTo.Value) then
					local model = v:Clone()
					model.Weld.Part0 = character[v.WeldTo.Value]
					model.Parent = character.Armor[type]
				end
			end

			for _,v in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
					v.Parent = character.Bin
				end
			end

			_G.createSound(Storage.Sounds.armor_equip_primary, torso):Play()
			_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.armor_equip), torso):Play()

			humanoid:UnequipTools()
			-- Note: Update this equip animation ID for R15
			pcall(function() loadAnim(humanoid.Animator, 15531364230):Play() end)
			return true
		elseif character.Armor[type]:GetAttribute("Tier") == tostring(tier) then
			character.Armor[type]:SetAttribute("Health", character.Armor[type]:GetAttribute("MaxHealth"))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
Storage.Events.giveArmor.Event:Connect(giveArmor)

function getArmorDamage(character, limbName, damage)
	local rawDamage, hasArmor, broke = damage, false, false
	local armorType = ArmorDatabase.LimbsToArmorType[limbName]
	if armorType and character:FindFirstChild("Armor") and character.Armor:FindFirstChild(armorType) and character.Armor[armorType]:GetAttribute("Equipped") and character.Armor[armorType]:GetAttribute("Health") > 0 then
		hasArmor = true
		local tierData = ArmorDatabase[armorType]["TIER_" .. character.Armor[armorType]:GetAttribute("Tier")]
		rawDamage *= tierData.rawDamageMultiplier
		local currentArmorHp = character.Armor[armorType]:GetAttribute("Health")
		character.Armor[armorType]:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(currentArmorHp - (damage * tierData.damageDealthMultiplier), 0))
		if character.Armor[armorType]:GetAttribute("Health") <= 0 and currentArmorHp > 0 then
			broke = true
		end
	end

	return rawDamage, hasArmor, broke
end

_G.burn = function(character, duration, damage, damageTick, attackerInfo, noRagdoll)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid:SetAttribute("BurningDuration", humanoid:GetAttribute("BurningDuration") + duration)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("BurningDamage", humanoid:GetAttribute("BurningDamage") + damage)

		if not humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") then
			local scream
			humanoid:SetAttribute("Burning", true)
			if humanoid.Health > 0 then
				scream = _G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.scream_burning), character.Head)
				scream.Name = "hurt"
				scream:Play()
				if not noRagdoll then
					Ragdoll.setGlobal(character, "muscles", true, "Burning", nil, math.huge)
				end
			end
			local euphoria = humanoid.Health > 0
			local burnTick = tick()
			while humanoid:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") do
				if tick() - burnTick >= humanoid:GetAttribute("BurningDuration") then
					break
				end

				humanoid:takeDamage(humanoid:GetAttribute("BurningDamage"))
				if not humanoid:GetAttribute("Euphoria") then
					flinch("", character)
				end
				if attackerInfo then
					CombatTag:addTag(character, attackerInfo.character, {damage = humanoid:GetAttribute("BurningDamage"), weapon = attackerInfo.weapon})
				end
				if humanoid.Health <= 0 and euphoria then
					euphoria = false
					if not noRagdoll or humanoid:GetAttribute("Euphoria") then
						Ragdoll.setGlobal(character, "muscles", false, nil, 16e-5)
					end
				end
				task.wait(damageTick)
			end

			if humanoid:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				humanoid:SetAttribute("BurningDuration", 0)
				humanoid:SetAttribute("Burning", false)

				if not noRagdoll or humanoid:GetAttribute("Euphoria") then
					Ragdoll.setGlobal(character, "muscles", false, nil, 16e-5)
				end
				if scream then
					scream:Destroy()
				end
			end
		elseif not noRagdoll and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Euphoria") and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			Ragdoll.setGlobal(character, "muscles", true, "Burning", nil, math.huge)
		end
	end
end

function findTool(parent, name)
	for _,v in pairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Tool") and v.ToolTip == name then
			return v
		end
	end

	return false
end

_G.explode = function(origin, data, attackerInfo, shakeInfo, explosionEffect, whitelist)
	if not whitelist then
		whitelist = {}
	end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Buildings}
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist
	local crater = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -10, 0), params)
	if crater then
		local size = math.random(1200, 1500) / 100
		createGuiSurface(
			"rbxassetid://2828069358",
			crater.Instance,
			crater.Position,
			128,
			Vector2.new(size, size),
			{
				["ImageTransparency"] = math.random(150, 250) / 1000,
				["Rotation"] = 0,
				["ResampleMode"] = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated,
			},
			16.5
		)

		local smokeEffect = Storage.Particles.ExplosionSmokeEffect.Attachment:Clone()
		smokeEffect.WorldCFrame = CFrame.new(origin)
		smokeEffect.Parent = workspace.Terrain
		task.delay(1.5, function()
			smokeEffect.Smoke.Enabled = true
			task.wait(10)
			smokeEffect.Smoke.Enabled = false
			Debris:AddItem(smokeEffect, 5)
		end)

		Network:FireAllClients("client", "grenade_debris", origin)
	end

	Network:FireAllClients("client", "createSound", getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.explosions), origin)
	emitParticle(explosionEffect or "ExplosionEffect", nil, origin, 10)

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Ignored}
	overlapParams.CollisionGroup = "Raycast"

	local targetHits = {}
	local hitted = {}
	local collideParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(origin, data.radius, overlapParams)
	for _,part in pairs(collideParts) do
		local target = isHumanoid(part)
		local player = target and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
		local pvp = player and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].pvp.Value or not player
		if target and target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Characters) and not table.find(whitelist, target) and not hitted[target] and part.Parent == target and part:GetAttribute("Enabled") and not target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField") and pvp and not isObstacle(origin, part, params) then
			hitted[target] = true
			targetHits[#targetHits + 1] = target

			task.defer(function()
				local lastHealth = target.Humanoid.Health
				local dead = false

				local ragdoll = false
				local dist = getDistance(target.Humanoid.RootPart, origin)
				local baseDamage = data.damage
				local damage = data.radius / (dist / 2) * baseDamage

				if damage > 30 or data.forceRagdoll then
					ragdoll = true
				end

				if attackerInfo then
					CombatTag:addTag(target, attackerInfo.character, {damage = damage, weapon = attackerInfo.weapon})
				end
				target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)

				if target.Humanoid.Health <= 0 and lastHealth > 0 then
					dead = true
				end

				local parts = {}
				if dead then
					for _,part in pairs(target:GetChildren()) do
						if part:IsA("BasePart") then
							local params = RaycastParams.new()
							params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {target}
							params.CollisionGroup = "Raycast"
							params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist

							local origin = part.Position + (part.CFrame.LookVector * -1)
							local dir = part.CFrame.LookVector * 2
							local cast = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, params)
							if cast then
								local gib,_ = _G.getGibFromPosition(part, cast.Position)
								Network:FireAllClients("client", "gore", target, cast.Instance, damage, gib, (target.Humanoid.RootPart.Position - origin).unit * 2, cast.Position, target.Head.CFrame.LookVector, cast.Normal, dead)
							end

							if math.random(2) == 1 and #parts < 3 then
								parts[#parts + 1] = part
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if ragdoll then
					target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("RagdollDur", 2.5)
					target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", true)

					local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
					force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
					force.Velocity = (target.Humanoid.RootPart.Position - origin).unit * math.clamp(damage / 4, 40, 150) + Vector3.new(0, math.random(30, 45), 0)
					force.Parent = part
					Debris:AddItem(force, 0.1)
					if part:GetAttribute("Enabled") then
						target.Humanoid.RootPart.Velocity = part.Velocity / 2
					end
				end
				emitParticle("BloodHitEffect", nil, target.Humanoid.RootPart.Position)

				if dead then
					task.defer(function()
						for _,part in pairs(parts) do
							if part:GetAttribute("Limbs") then
								part:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
								_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.fleshHits), part):Play()
								emitParticle("BloodHitEffect", nil, part.Position)
							end
						end
					end)
				end
			end)
		elseif target and target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Objects) then
			task.wait(1 / 15)
			if attackerInfo then
				CombatTag:addTag(target, attackerInfo.character, {damage = 1000, weapon = attackerInfo.weapon})
			end
			target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(1000)
		elseif not target and part:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Glass) then
			Storage.Events.glass:Fire(part, part.Position, (part.Position - origin).unit * 30 + Vector3.new(0, math.random(8, 12), 0))
		end
	end

	table.clear(hitted)
	hitted = nil

	for _,player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local pChar = player.Character
		local pHum = pChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if pHum.Health > 0 and pHum.RootPart and getDistance(pHum.RootPart, origin) <= shakeInfo.maxDist then
			local dist = getDistance(pHum.RootPart, origin)
			Storage.Events.shake:FireClient(player, shakeInfo.springConfig, math.clamp(shakeInfo.strength - dist, shakeInfo.min, shakeInfo.max), shakeInfo.dur, shakeInfo.blur)
		end
	end

	return targetHits
end

local function handleGrenade(player, character, humanoid, tool, dir)
	local settings = require(Storage.Modules.Weapons[tool.Name])
	local x0 = tool._mod[settings.handle].CFrame + (dir.unit * 2)
	local v0 = (humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") or humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed")) and (tool._mod[settings.handle].Position + Vector3.new(0, -10, 0)).unit * 5 or dir.unit * settings.speed + Vector3.new(0, settings.upForce, 0)
	local model = Storage.Models.Projectiles[tool.Name]:Clone()
	--model.PrimaryPart.CFrame = x0
	model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(x0)
	model.Parent = workspace.Ignored
	model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
	for _,v in pairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if not v.Anchored then
			v:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end
	end
	model.PrimaryPart.Velocity = v0
	model.PrimaryPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 20)
	if settings.type == "molotov" then
		for _,v in pairs(model.Cloth.Bone:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("Sound") then
				v:Play()
				break
			end
		end

		local ignoreParts = {workspace.Ignored, model}
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreParts
		local lastPos = model.PrimaryPart.Position
		local connection
		local step = 0
		connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if tick() - step >= 1 / 15 then
				step = tick()

				if model.PrimaryPart then
					local cast = workspace:Raycast(lastPos, model.PrimaryPart.Position - lastPos, params)
					if cast then
						connection:Disconnect()
						task.wait(1 / 15)
						for _,v in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
							if v:IsA("BasePart") and cast.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water then
								v.Transparency = 1
							elseif v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Light") then
								v.Enabled = false
							end
						end
						Debris:AddItem(model, 5)

						if cast.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water then
							model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
							model.PrimaryPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(cast.Position)
							model.PrimaryPart.Velocity = Vector3.new()
							Network:FireAllClients("client", "projectile_debris", model.Name, cast.Position, cast.Normal, lastPos)
						else
							model.PrimaryPart.Velocity *= 0.1
							model.PrimaryPart.RotVelocity *= 0.1
							model.PrimaryPart.CanCollide = true
						end

						if cast.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water then
							_G.createSound(Storage.Miscs.Weapons.Molotov.Sounds.Impact, model.PrimaryPart):Play()
							_G.createSound(Storage.Miscs.Weapons.Molotov.Sounds.Explode, model.PrimaryPart):Play()

							for _,player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
								local pChar = player.Character
								local pHum = pChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
								if pHum.Health > 0 and pHum.RootPart and getDistance(pHum.RootPart, humanoid.RootPart) <= 150 then
									local dist = getDistance(pHum.RootPart, humanoid.RootPart)
									Storage.Events.shake:FireClient(player, {Damping = 1.2}, math.clamp(60 - dist, 5, 30), 0.8, true)
								end
							end

							local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
							overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Ignored, workspace.Buildings}
							overlapParams.CollisionGroup = "Raycast"

							local function handleFireHitbox(firePart)
								task.defer(function()
									while firePart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and firePart:GetAttribute("Enabled") do
										local hitted = {}
										local collideParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(firePart.CFrame + (firePart.CFrame.UpVector * 2.5), firePart.Size + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), overlapParams)
										for _,part in pairs(collideParts) do
											if part:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Characters) and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
												local target = isHumanoid(part)
												local player = target and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
												local pvp = player and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].pvp.Value or not player
												if target and not hitted[target] and not target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField") and pvp then
													hitted[target] = true

													target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("BurnHit", true)
													target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("BurnCount", target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") + 1)
													if target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") <= 1 then
														task.spawn(function()
															while target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") >= 1 do
																task.wait(1.5)
																if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and target:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
																	local n = target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") - 1
																	target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("BurnCount", math.max(n, 0))
																end
															end
														end)
													end
													local lastBurnCount = target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount")
													task.delay(1, function()
														if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and (target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") < lastBurnCount or target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") <= 0) then
															target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("BurnHit", false)
														end
													end)
													target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(10)
													CombatTag:addTag(target, character, {damage = 10, weapon = "Molotov Cocktail"})
													if target.Humanoid.Health > 0 and not target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") and target:FindFirstChild("Head") then
														local hurt = _G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.light_hurt), target.Head)
														hurt.Name = "hurt"
														hurt:Play()
													end
													if target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") >= 5 then
														task.defer(function() _G.burn(target, 3, target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") and 0 or 5, 0.1, {character = character, weapon = "Molotov Cocktail"}) end)
													end
												end
											end
										end

										table.clear(hitted)
										hitted = nil

										task.wait(math.random(40, 60) / 100)
									end
								end)
							end

							if not isHumanoid(cast.Instance) and (cast.Instance.Material ~= Enum.Material.Glass or not cast.Instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Glass)) then
								if normalIdFromVector(cast.Normal) ~= Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
									local fireHitbox = Storage.Models.fireHitbox:Clone()
									fireHitbox.CFrame = CFrame.new(cast.Position + (cast.Normal * 0.15), cast.Position + (cast.Normal * 2)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
									if not cast.Instance.Anchored then
										local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
										weld.Part0 = cast.Instance
										weld.Part1 = fireHitbox
										weld.Parent = fireHitbox
										fireHitbox.Anchored = false
									end
									local size = normalIdFromVector(cast.Normal) == Enum.NormalId.Top and math.random(12, 15) or 8
									local hitted = {}
									local collideParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(cast.Position + cast.Normal), Vector3.new(size, size, size), overlapParams)
									for _,part in pairs(collideParts) do
										if part:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Characters) and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
											local target = isHumanoid(part)
											local player = target and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
											local pvp = player and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].pvp.Value or not player
											if target and not hitted[target] and not target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField") and pvp then
												local params = RaycastParams.new()
												params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Ignored, fireHitbox, workspace.Characters}
												if not isObstacle(fireHitbox, part, params) then
													hitted[target] = true

													task.defer(function() _G.burn(target, 3, humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") and 0 or 1.5, 0.15, {character = character, weapon = "Molotov Cocktail"}) end)
													ignoreParts[#ignoreParts + 1] = target
													params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreParts
												end
											end
										end
									end

									table.clear(hitted)
									hitted = nil

									fireHitbox.Size = Vector3.new(0.001, 0.001, 0.001)
									fireHitbox.fire:Play()
									fireHitbox.Parent = workspace.Ignored
									task.delay(15, function()
										fireHitbox:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
										for _,v in pairs(fireHitbox:GetChildren()) do
											if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Light") then
												if v.Name == "Smoke1" and v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
													v.TimeScale = 0
													v.Rate = 0
												end
												v.Enabled = false
											elseif v:IsA("Sound") then
												TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(2.5), {Volume = 0}):Play()
											end
										end
										task.wait(5)
										fireHitbox.Smoke1.TimeScale = 1
										Debris:AddItem(fireHitbox, 3)
									end)
									TweenService:Create(fireHitbox, TweenInfo.new(5), {Size = Vector3.new(size, 0.001, size)}):Play()
									handleFireHitbox(fireHitbox)
								end
							elseif cast.Instance.Material ~= Enum.Material.Glass or not cast.Instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Glass) then
								local target = isHumanoid(cast.Instance)
								task.defer(function() _G.burn(target, 3, target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") and 0 or 1.5, 0.1, {character = character, weapon = "Molotov Cocktail"}) end)
								ignoreParts[#ignoreParts + 1] = target
								params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreParts
							elseif cast.Instance.Material == Enum.Material.Glass and cast.Instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Glass) then
								_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.glass_hit), cast.Instance):Play()
								cast.Instance:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(cast.Instance:GetAttribute("Health") - cast.Instance:GetAttribute("MaxHealth"), 0))
								if cast.Instance:GetAttribute("Health") <= 0 then
									Storage.Events.glass:Fire(cast.Instance, cast.Position, (cast.Instance.CFrame.p - character.Head.CFrame.p).unit * math.random(30, 40))
								end
							end

							local n = emitParticle("FireExplosionEffect", nil, cast.Position)
							n.WorldCFrame = CFrame.new(cast.Position, cast.Position + cast.Normal) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)

							if normalIdFromVector(cast.Normal) ~= Enum.NormalId.Top then
								for k = 1, math.random(4, 6) do
									local flame_cast = workspace:Raycast(cast.Position + cast.Normal, Vector3.new(math.random(-500, 500) / 100, -30, math.random(-500, 500) / 100), params)
									if flame_cast and flame_cast.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water then
										if not isHumanoid(flame_cast.Instance) then
											local fireHitbox = Storage.Models.fireHitbox:Clone()
											fireHitbox.CFrame = CFrame.new(flame_cast.Position + (flame_cast.Normal * 0.15), flame_cast.Position + (flame_cast.Normal * 2)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
											if not flame_cast.Instance.Anchored then
												local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
												weld.Part0 = flame_cast.Instance
												weld.Part1 = fireHitbox
												weld.Parent = fireHitbox
												fireHitbox.Anchored = false
											end
											local size = math.random(8, 15)
											fireHitbox.Size = Vector3.new(0.001, 0.001, 0.001)
											fireHitbox.fire:Play()
											fireHitbox.Parent = workspace.Ignored
											task.delay(12, function()
												fireHitbox:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
												for _,v in pairs(fireHitbox:GetChildren()) do
													if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Light") then
														if v.Name == "Smoke1" and v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
															v.TimeScale = 0
															v.Rate = 0
														end
														v.Enabled = false
													elseif v:IsA("Sound") then
														TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(2.5), {Volume = 0}):Play()
													end
												end
												task.wait(5)
												fireHitbox.Smoke1.TimeScale = 1
												Debris:AddItem(fireHitbox, 3)
											end)
											TweenService:Create(fireHitbox, TweenInfo.new(5), {Size = Vector3.new(size, 0.001, size)}):Play()
											handleFireHitbox(fireHitbox)
										else
											local target = isHumanoid(flame_cast.Instance)
											task.defer(function() _G.burn(target, 3, target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") and 0 or 1.5, 0.1, {character = character, weapon = "Molotov Cocktail"}) end)
										end

										local n = emitParticle("FireExplosionEffect", nil, flame_cast.Position)
										n.WorldCFrame = CFrame.new(flame_cast.Position, flame_cast.Position + flame_cast.Normal) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
									end
									task.wait(1 / 10)
								end
							end
						end
					end

					lastPos = model.PrimaryPart.Position
				else
					connection:Disconnect()
					model:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end)
	elseif settings.type == "frag_grenade" then
		Network:FireAllClients("client", "grenade_impact", model)
		local forceParts = {"Latch", "Pin", "Pinloop"}
		for _,v in pairs(forceParts) do
			model[v].Velocity = dir.unit * 30
			model[v].RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 50)
		end
		local ignoreParts = {workspace.Ignored, model, character}
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreParts
		local lastPos = model.PrimaryPart.Position
		local connection
		local step = 0
		local bounce = 0
		connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if tick() - step >= 1 / 15 then
				step = tick()

				if model.PrimaryPart then
					if not model.PrimaryPart.CanCollide then
						local cast = workspace:Raycast(model.PrimaryPart.Position, model.PrimaryPart.Velocity.unit * 15 + Vector3.new(0, -5, 0), params)
						if cast then
							model.PrimaryPart.CanCollide = true
						end
					end

					local cast = workspace:Raycast(model.PrimaryPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0), params)
					if cast then
						bounce += 1
						if bounce > settings.maxBounce then
							connection:Disconnect()
							model.PrimaryPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(model.PrimaryPart.Velocity.x / 2, model.PrimaryPart.Velocity.y, model.PrimaryPart.Velocity.z / 2)
							model.PrimaryPart.RotVelocity /= 2
							local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
							force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
							force.Velocity = Vector3.new()
							force.Parent = model.PrimaryPart

							task.wait(0.8)
							for _,v in pairs(model.PrimaryPart.Blip:GetChildren()) do
								if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
									v.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
								end
							end
							task.wait(0.5)
							for _,v in pairs(model.PrimaryPart.Blip:GetChildren()) do
								if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
									v.Enabled = false
								end
							end
							model.Handle.Transparency = 1
							model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
							model.PrimaryPart.CanCollide = false
							model.PrimaryPart.Velocity = Vector3.new()
							model.PrimaryPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new()
							task.defer(function() _G.explode(model.PrimaryPart.Position, {damage = settings.damage, radius = settings.radius}, {character = character, weapon = tool.Name}, settings.explosionConfig) end)
							task.wait(5)
							model:Destroy()
							return
						end
					end

					lastPos = model.PrimaryPart.Position
				else
					connection:Disconnect()
					model:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	tool:SetAttribute("Dropped", true)
	for _,v in pairs(tool._mod:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			v.Transparency = 1
		elseif v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			v:Destroy()
		elseif v:IsA("Light") then
			v.Brightness = 0
		end
	end
	task.wait(1 / 2)
	tool.Parent = workspace.Ignored
	Debris:AddItem(tool, 3)
end

local function fire(character, tool, player, dir)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid.Health > 0 and typeof(tool) == "Instance" and tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:IsDescendantOf(character) then
		local settings = require(Storage.Modules.Weapons[tool.Name])
		--Storage.Events.client:Fire("fire", tool.Name, character.Head.Position, mouse.UnitRay.Direction, character, handle, 2500, true)
		if tool._data.magCurrent.Value > 0 and (not player or tick() - playersEventRate[player].fire >= (settings.rate / 2)) and settings.gunType ~= "diy_ft" then
			if player then
				Network:FireOtherClients(player, "client", "fire", tool.Name, tool._mod.Handle.MuzzleFX.WorldPosition, dir, character, tool._mod.Handle)
			else
				Network:FireAllClients("client", "fire", tool.Name, tool._mod.Handle.MuzzleFX.WorldPosition, dir, character, tool._mod.Handle)
			end
		end
		if player then
			playersEventRate[player].fire = tick()
		end
		tool:SetAttribute("BulletHit", 0)

		if tool._data.magCurrent.Value > 0 then
			tool:SetAttribute("LastAmmo", tool._data.magCurrent.Value)
		end
		tool._data.magCurrent.Value -= 1
		if tool._data.magCurrent.Value < 1 then
			if settings.gunType == "rpg" and tool._mod:FindFirstChild("Rocket") then
				for _,v in pairs(tool._mod.Rocket:GetChildren()) do
					if v:IsA("BasePart") then
						v.Transparency = 1
					end
				end
			elseif settings.gunType == "diy_ft" then
				tool:SetAttribute("Dropped", true)
				task.delay(1, function()
					if tool:IsDescendantOf(character) then
						humanoid:UnequipTools()
						task.wait(1 / 30)
					end
					tool.Motor.Part0 = nil
					tool.Motor.Enabled = false
					tool._mod.Handle.Can.Enabled = false
					tool.Parent = workspace.Ignored
					for _,v in pairs(tool._mod:GetChildren()) do
						if v:IsA("BasePart") then
							if v.Name == "Hitbox" then
								v:Destroy()
							else
								v.CollisionGroup = "Debris"
								v.CanCollide = true
								if v:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
									v:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
								end
							end
						end
					end
					Debris:AddItem(tool, 3)
				end)

				return
			end
		end

		if settings.gunType == "rpg" and tool._mod:FindFirstChild("Rocket") then
			local rocket = Storage.Models.Rocket:Clone()
			rocket.Transparency = 0
			rocket.Main.CFrame = CFrame.new(tool._mod.Rocket.CFrame.Position, tool._mod.Rocket.CFrame.Position + (dir * 2))
			rocket.Parent = workspace.Ignored
			rocket.Main:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
			for _,v in pairs(rocket.Attachment:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Light") then
					v.Enabled = true
				end
			end
			rocket.flying:Play()
			rocket.launch:Play()

			local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
			force.Velocity = dir * 150
			force.Parent = rocket.Main

			--[[local gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
			gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
			gyro.CFrame = rocket.CFrame
			gyro.Parent = rocket.Main]]

			local start = tick()
			local lastPos = rocket.Main.Position

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Ignored, character}

			local originCF = rocket.Main.CFrame
			local degree = 0
			local exploded = false
			while tick() - start < 10 do
				local cast = workspace:Raycast(lastPos, rocket.Main.Position - lastPos, params)
				if cast then
					exploded = true
					rocket.Main.Anchored = true
					rocket.Transparency = 1
					for _,v in pairs(rocket.Attachment:GetChildren()) do
						if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Light") then
							v.Enabled = false
						end
					end
					rocket.flying:Stop()
					rocket.launch:Stop()
					Debris:AddItem(rocket, 3)

					Network:FireAllClients("client", "createSound", getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.explosions), cast.Position)

					local params = RaycastParams.new()
					params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Buildings}
					params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist
					local crater = workspace:Raycast(cast.Position + cast.Normal, dir * 100, params)
					if crater then
						local size = math.random(1500, 2000) / 100
						createGuiSurface(
							"rbxassetid://2828069358",
							crater.Instance,
							crater.Position,
							128,
							Vector2.new(size, size),
							{
								["ImageTransparency"] = math.random(450, 750) / 1000,
								["Rotation"] = 0,
								["ResampleMode"] = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated,
							},
							10
						)
					end

					for _,player in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
						local pChar = player.Character
						local pHum = pChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
						if pHum.Health > 0 and pHum.RootPart and getDistance(pHum.RootPart, cast.Position) <= 250 then
							local dist = getDistance(pHum.RootPart, cast.Position)
							Storage.Events.shake:FireClient(player, {Damping = 1.2}, math.clamp(150 - dist, 20, 120), 1.5, true)
						end
					end

					local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
					explosion.BlastPressure = 0
					explosion.BlastRadius = 30
					explosion.ExplosionType = Enum.ExplosionType.NoCraters
					explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
					explosion.Position = cast.Position
					explosion.Parent = workspace.Terrain

					local targets = {}
					local params = OverlapParams.new()
					params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {tool}
					local collideParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(cast.Position, 30, params)
					for _,part in pairs(collideParts) do
						local target = isHumanoid(part)
						local targetPlayer = target and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
						local pvp = targetPlayer and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[targetPlayer.Name].pvp.Value or not targetPlayer
						if target and not targets[target] and target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Characters) and not target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField") and pvp and (not targetPlayer or targetPlayer ~= player) then
							targets[target] = true

							task.defer(function()
								local parts = {}
								if target.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
									for _,part in pairs(target:GetChildren()) do
										if part:IsA("BasePart") then
											parts[#parts + 1] = part

											if math.random(5) == 1 then
												break
											end
										end
									end
								end

								CombatTag:addTag(target, character, {damage = 150, weapon = tool.Name})
								target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(150)
								target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("RagdollDur", 3.5)
								target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", true)

								local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
								force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
								force.Velocity = (target.Humanoid.RootPart.Position - cast.Position).unit * math.random(30, 40) + Vector3.new(0, math.random(30, 40), 0)
								force.Parent = part
								Debris:AddItem(force, 0.1)
								part.RotVelocity = part.Velocity * 2

								task.defer(function()
									for _,part in pairs(parts) do
										part:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
										if part:GetAttribute("Limbs") then
											part:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
											_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.fleshHits), part):Play()
											_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.gore_ripped), part):Play()
											emitParticle("BloodHitEffect", nil, part.Position)
										end
									end
								end)
							end)
						elseif target and target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Objects) then
							task.wait(1 / 15)
							if target:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
								CombatTag:addTag(target, character, {damage = 1000, weapon = tool.Name})
								target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(1000)
							end
						elseif not target and part:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Glass) then
							Storage.Events.glass:Fire(part, part.Position, (part.Position - cast.Position).unit * 35 + Vector3.new(0, math.random(8, 12), 0))
						end
					end

					local connection
					connection = explosion.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_,parent)
						if parent == nil then
							connection:Disconnect()
							table.clear(targets)
						end
					end)

					break
				end

				lastPos = rocket.Main.Position
				task.wait(1 / 15)
			end

			if not exploded then
				rocket:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end

local wallCheckParams = RaycastParams.new()
wallCheckParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Buildings}
wallCheckParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist
wallCheckParams.IgnoreWater = true
wallCheckParams.CollisionGroup = "Raycast"
local function getWallsPierced(head, hitPart, walls, ignoreList)
	if not walls then
		walls = 0
	end
	if not ignoreList then
		ignoreList = {workspace.Ignored, workspace.Buildings.Objects, workspace.Characters, workspace.Terrain, workspace.Objects}
	end

	local wallCheckParams = RaycastParams.new()
	wallCheckParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
	wallCheckParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
	wallCheckParams.IgnoreWater = true
	wallCheckParams.CollisionGroup = "Raycast"
	local wallCheck = workspace:Raycast(head.CFrame.Position, hitPart.CFrame.Position - head.CFrame.Position, wallCheckParams)
	if wallCheck then
		ignoreList[#ignoreList + 1] = wallCheck.Instance
		walls += 1
		return getWallsPierced(head, hitPart, walls, ignoreList)
	end

	return walls
end

local function damage(player, target, tool, hitPart, vel, result, dir)
	local character = player:IsA("Player") and player.Character or player
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid.Health > 0 and (not humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") or findSecondaryWeapon(character)) and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Carried") and typeof(tool) == "Instance" and tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:IsDescendantOf(character) and Storage.Modules.Weapons:FindFirstChild(tool.Name) and hitPart:IsDescendantOf(target) and tool._data.magCurrent.Value >= 0 and tool._data.reload.reloading.Value == false and not target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField") and not playerHasActivity(player) --[[and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)]] then
		if ((Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[target.Name].pvp.Value == false) or (player:IsA("Player") and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].pvp.Value == false)) and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) then
			local text = ""
			if player:IsA("Player") then
				if ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].pvp.Value == false then
					text = "YOU HAVE PVP MODE OFF"
				elseif Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[target.Name].pvp.Value == false then
					text = "TARGET HAS PVP MODE OFF"
				end
			end

			return false, nil, nil, {
				prop = {
					Text = text,
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 94, 97),
				},
				err = true,
				dur = 1,
			}
		end

		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not head then
			return false
		end

		local settings = require(Storage.Modules.Weapons[tool.Name])
		if (tool._data.magCurrent.Value >= tool:GetAttribute("LastAmmo") or tool:GetAttribute("BulletHit") >= settings.amountPerRound) and settings.magCurrent ~= math.huge then
			return false
		end

		local rawDamage = math.random(settings.damage[1], settings.damage[2]) / settings.amountPerRound

		local dist = getDistance(humanoid.RootPart, target.Humanoid.RootPart)
		local minDamage = rawDamage / 2
		local damage = math.max(rawDamage - (dist / 20), minDamage)

		if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Characters) and target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") ~= nil then
			tool:SetAttribute("BulletHit", tool:GetAttribute("BulletHit") + 1)
			local downed = target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed")
			local headshot = isHead(hitPart, target)
			if settings.gunType == "diy_ft" then
				local params = RaycastParams.new()
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Ignored, target, character}
				params.CollisionGroup = "Raycast"
				if not isObstacle(head, hitPart, params) then
					target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("BurnHit", true)
					target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("BurnCount", target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") + 1)
					if target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") <= 1 then
						task.spawn(function()
							while target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") >= 1 do
								task.wait(1.5)
								if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and target:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
									local n = target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") - 1
									target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("BurnCount", math.max(n, 0))
								end
							end
						end)
					end

					local lastBurnCount = target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount")
					task.delay(1, function()
						if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and (target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") < lastBurnCount or target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") <= 0) then
							target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("BurnHit", false)
						end
					end)
					target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(1.5)
					if target.Humanoid.Health > 0 and not target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") and target:FindFirstChild("Head") then
						local hurt = _G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.light_hurt), target.Head)
						hurt.Name = "hurt"
						hurt:Play()
					end
					if target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") >= 5 and target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") < 10 and not target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") then
						task.defer(function() _G.burn(target, 3, target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") and 0 or 1, 0.1, {character = character, weapon = tool.Name}, true) end)
					elseif target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("BurnCount") == 15 then
						task.defer(function() _G.burn(target, 3, target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Burning") and 0 or 1, 0.1, {character = character, weapon = tool.Name}) end)
					end
				end
			else
				if headshot then
					damage *= settings.headshotMultiplier
				end
					--[[if downed then
						damage = math.max(damage / 3, 1)
					end]]
				if downed then
					damage *= 2
				end
				local armorAdjustedDamage, hasArmor, armorBroke = getArmorDamage(target, hitPart.Name, damage)
				if hasArmor then
					damage = armorAdjustedDamage

					if armorBroke and result then
						emitParticle("ArmorHitEffect", nil, result.Position + result.Normal)
					end
				end
				if humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") then
					damage /= 2
				end
				local wallPierced = getWallsPierced(head, hitPart)
				if wallPierced > 0 then
					damage = math.clamp(damage / (wallPierced + 1), damage / 3, damage)
				end

				if hitPart:GetAttribute("Limbs") then
					hitPart:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(hitPart:GetAttribute("Health") - (damage * 1.5), 0))
					if headshot and hitPart:GetAttribute("Health") <= 0 then
						damage = target.Humanoid.Health
					end
				end

				local lastHealth = target.Humanoid.Health
				local dead = false
				local painAnim = ((target.Humanoid.Health - damage) / target.Humanoid.MaxHealth) * 100 < 15-- and not target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed")
				CombatTag:addTag(target, character, {damage = damage, weapon = tool.Name})
				target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
				if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) then
					Storage.Events.hitPos:FireClient(Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target), humanoid.RootPart, 3)
				end
				if target.Humanoid.Health <= 0 and lastHealth > 0 then
					dead = true
				end
				if dead and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) then
					humanoid.Health += 20
				end
				if target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") or target.Humanoid.Health <= damage then
					local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
					force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
					force.Velocity = (vel.unit + (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.UpVector / 2)) * settings.knockback * (headshot and 1 or 0.8)
					force.Parent = hitPart
					Debris:AddItem(force, 0.1)
				end

				if not hasArmor and result then
					emitParticle("BloodHitEffect", nil, result.Position)
				end
				flinch(hitPart.Name, target)
				if result and hitPart:GetAttribute("Limbs") and hitPart:GetAttribute("Health") <= 0 then
					local gib,_ = _G.getGibFromPosition(hitPart, result.Position)
					Network:FireAllClients("client", "gore", target, hitPart, damage, gib, dir, result.Position, character.Head.CFrame.LookVector, result.Normal, dead)
				end

				do
					local lookVector = character.Head.CFrame.LookVector
					local force = lookVector - (2 * lookVector:Dot(result.Normal) * result.Normal)
					local cf = hitPart.CFrame:toObjectSpace(CFrame.new(result.Position, result.Position + force))
					Network:FireAllClientsWithinDistance(hitPart.Position, 150, "client", "blood", target, hitPart, {
						cf = cf,
						amount = math.clamp(damage / 5, 1, 8),
						cd = {1, 3, 100},
						vel = {
							x = {min = -350, max = 350, d = 100},
							y = {min = -350, max = 350, d = 100},
							z = {min = -350, max = 350, d = 100}
						},
						strength = {min = 90, max = 120},
						up = {min = -15, max = 5},
						size = {min = 30, max = 100, d = 100}
					})
				end

				if result then
					if headshot then
						_G.createSound(hasArmor and getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.helmet_hit) or getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.fleshHits), result.Position):Play()
					else
						_G.createSound(hasArmor and getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.kevlar_hit) or getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.fleshHeadshotHits), result.Position):Play()
					end
				end

				if (not dead and target.Humanoid.Health <= 0 and not target.Humanoid:FindFirstChild("killed")) then
					local kill = Instance.new("StringValue")
					kill.Name = "killed"
					kill.Parent = target.Humanoid
				end

				if painAnim and (not dead or math.random(3) == 1) then
					if (target:FindFirstChild("hurt")) then
						task.wait(1 / 15)
					end
					if (not target:FindFirstChild("hurt")) then
						-- R15 Fix: Expanded check for various Leg parts
						local isLeg = string.find(hitPart.Name, "Leg") or string.find(hitPart.Name, "Foot")
						local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
						force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(8e4, 8e4, 8e4)
						force.Velocity = vel.unit * 10
						force.Parent = hitPart
						Debris:AddItem(force, 0.15)

						--[[if (not isLeg) then
							gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
							gyro.P = 100
							gyro.Parent = target.UpperTorso
							Debris:AddItem(gyro, math.random(1, 2))
						end]]
						local gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
						gyro.P = 100
						-- R15 Fix: Torso to UpperTorso
						gyro.Parent = target:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or target:FindFirstChild("Torso")
						Debris:AddItem(gyro, isLeg and 0.8 or math.random(1, 2))
						local hurt = Instance.new("StringValue")
						hurt.Name = "hurt"
						hurt.Parent = target

						local torso = target:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or target:FindFirstChild("Torso")
						local collisionGroup = torso and torso.CollisionGroupId or 0
						--target.UpperTorso.CollisionGroup = "OnlySelfCollisions"

						local startTick = tick()
						local move = tick()
						local stop = dead and (isHead(hitPart, target) and (math.random(50, 450) / 100) or 4) or 6

						task.spawn(function()
							Ragdoll.setGlobal(target, "muscles", true, hitPart, nil, stop)
							while target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and target:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and tick() - startTick < stop and (target.Humanoid.Health > 0 or dead) do
								if (target.Humanoid:FindFirstChild("killed")) then
									break
								end

								if (gyro and torso) then
									gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(torso.Position, torso.Position + torso.CFrame.LookVector * 100)
								end

								task.wait(1 / 30)
							end
							local now = 16e-6
							if (tick() - startTick >= stop - 0.1) then
								now = 1
							end
							if (gyro) then
								gyro:Destroy()
							end
							if (lastHealth - target.Humanoid.Health >= 5 or target.Humanoid.Health <= 0 or dead or tick() - startTick >= stop - 0.1) then
								Ragdoll.setGlobal(target, "muscles", false, nil, now)
							end
							hurt:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			return true, headshot, dead
		elseif target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Objects) then
			tool:SetAttribute("BulletHit", tool:GetAttribute("BulletHit") + 1)
			local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
			force.Velocity = vel.unit * settings.knockback
			force.Parent = hitPart
			Debris:AddItem(force, 0.1)
			local lastHealth = target.Humanoid.Health
			local dead = false
			local wallPierced = getWallsPierced(head, hitPart)
			if wallPierced > 0 then
				damage = math.clamp(damage / (wallPierced + 1), damage / 3, damage)
			end
			CombatTag:addTag(target, character, {damage = damage, weapon = tool.Name})
			target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
			if target.Humanoid.Health <= 0 and lastHealth > 0 then
				dead = true
			end

			return true, false, dead
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function meleeDamage(player, target, tool, hitPart, dirV3, result)
	local character = player:IsA("Player") and player.Character or player
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid.Health > 0 and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and typeof(tool) == "Instance" and tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:IsDescendantOf(character) and Storage.Modules.Weapons:FindFirstChild(tool.Name) and hitPart:IsDescendantOf(target) and not target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField") and getDistance(humanoid.RootPart, target.Humanoid.RootPart) < 12 and not playerHasActivity(player) --[[and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)]] then
		if ((Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[target.Name].pvp.Value == false) or (player:IsA("Player") and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].pvp.Value == false)) and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) then
			return false
		end

		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not head then
			return false
		end

		local wallCheck = workspace:Raycast(humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.Position, hitPart.CFrame.Position - humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.Position, wallCheckParams)
		if wallCheck and not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Objects) then
			return false
		end

		local settings = require(Storage.Modules.Weapons[tool.Name])
		local rawDamage = math.random(settings.damage[1], settings.damage[2])
		if not tool:GetAttribute("Melee") and settings.anims.shove then
			rawDamage = math.random(settings.damage_shove[1], settings.damage_shove[2])
		end

		local minDamage = math.min(rawDamage / 2, 10)
		local maxRange = 300
		local minRange = 15

		local dist = getDistance(humanoid.RootPart, target.Humanoid.RootPart)
		local damageRange = math.clamp(dist, minRange, maxRange)
		local t = (damageRange - minRange) / (maxRange - minRange)
		local damage = rawDamage - t * (rawDamage - minDamage)

		if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Characters) and (tool:GetAttribute("Melee") or settings.anims.shove) then
			local sessionProfile = player:IsA("Player") and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles:WaitForChild(player.Name)
			local isFinisher = not player:IsA("Player") and player:GetAttribute("finish") or player:IsA("Player") and sessionProfile.finish.Value
			if isFinisher and not target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and target.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				return false
			end
			local downed = target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed")
			local headshot = isHead(hitPart, target)
			if headshot then
				damage *= settings.headshotMultiplier
			end
			--[[if downed then
				damage = math.max(damage / 3, 1)
			end]]

			if downed then
				damage *= 2
			end
			local armorAdjustedDamage, hasArmor, armorBroke = getArmorDamage(target, hitPart.Name, damage)
			if hasArmor then
				damage = armorAdjustedDamage

				if armorBroke then
					emitParticle("ArmorHitEffect", nil, result.Position + result.Normal)
				end
			end

			if hitPart:GetAttribute("Limbs") then
				hitPart:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(hitPart:GetAttribute("Health") - (damage * 1.5), 0))
				if headshot and hitPart:GetAttribute("Health") <= 0 then
					damage = target.Humanoid.Health
				end
			end

			-- // finisher system, calling a module for a specific weapon
			--print(damage)

			local lastHealth = target.Humanoid.Health
			local dead = false
			CombatTag:addTag(target, character, {damage = damage, weapon = tool.Name})
			target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
			if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) then
				Storage.Events.hitPos:FireClient(Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target), humanoid.RootPart, 3)
				Storage.Events.melee2:FireClient(Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target))
			end
			local finisher = false
			if isFinisher then
				if not player:IsA("Player") then
					player:SetAttribute("finish", false)
				else
					sessionProfile.finish.Value = false
				end
				finisher = true
				pcall(function() require(StorageServer.Modules.Finisher.Normal[tool.Name])(result, target, character, humanoid, tool, settings, hitPart, dirV3, sessionProfile, true) end)
			end
			if target.Humanoid.Health <= 0 and lastHealth > 0 then
				dead = true
			end
			if finisher and dead and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) then
				humanoid.Health += 50
			end
			if (target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") or target.Humanoid.Health <= damage) and not isFinisher then
				local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e11, 1e11, 1e11)
				force.Velocity = (dirV3.unit + (humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.UpVector / 2)) * settings.knockback * (headshot and 1 or 0.8)
				force.Parent = hitPart
				Debris:AddItem(force, 0.1)
			end

			if tool:GetAttribute("Melee") then
				task.defer(function() require(StorageServer.Modules.Finisher.Normal[tool.Name])(result, target, character, humanoid, tool, settings, hitPart, dirV3, sessionProfile, false) end)
			end

			if tool._mod[settings.handle or "Handle"]:FindFirstChild("sounds") and tool:IsDescendantOf(character) and tool._mod:FindFirstChild(settings.handle or "Handle") then
				if tool._mod[settings.handle or "Handle"].sounds:FindFirstChild("Hits") then
					_G.createSound(getRandomChild(tool._mod[settings.handle or "Handle"].sounds.Hits), hitPart, nil, nil, 0.3):Play()
				elseif tool._mod[settings.handle or "Handle"].sounds:FindFirstChild("Hit") then
					_G.createSound(tool._mod[settings.handle or "Handle"].sounds.Hit, hitPart, nil, nil, 0.3):Play()
				end
			end

			if not hasArmor then
				emitParticle("BloodMeleeHitEffect", nil, result.Position)
			end
			flinch(hitPart.Name, target)

			if settings.gore_settings and settings.gore_settings.gore and hitPart:GetAttribute("Limbs") and hitPart:GetAttribute("Health") <= 0 then
				local gib,_ = _G.getGibFromPosition(hitPart, result.Position)
				Network:FireAllClients("client", "gore", target, hitPart, damage, gib, dirV3, result.Position, character.Head.CFrame.LookVector, result.Normal, dead)
			end

			if settings.gore_settings and settings.gore_settings.gore then
				do
					local cf = hitPart.CFrame:toObjectSpace(CFrame.new(result.Position, result.Position + dirV3))
					Network:FireAllClientsWithinDistance(hitPart.Position, 150, "client", "blood", target, hitPart, {
						cf = cf,
						amount = math.clamp(damage / 5, 1, 8),
						lookVector = character.Head.CFrame.LookVector,
						normal = result.Normal,
						cd = {1, 3, 100},
						vel = {
							x = {min = -200, max = 200, d = 100},
							y = {min = -200, max = 200, d = 100},
							z = {min = -200, max = 200, d = 100}
						},
						strength = {min = 60, max = 80},
						up = {min = -15, max = 5},
						size = {min = 30, max = 100, d = 100}
					})
				end
			end

			--[[if headshot then
				_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.fleshHits), result.Position):Play()
			else
				_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.fleshHeadshotHits), result.Position):Play()
			end]]

			if (not dead and target.Humanoid.Health <= 0 and not target.Humanoid:FindFirstChild("killed")) then
				local kill = Instance.new("StringValue")
				kill.Name = "killed"
				kill.Parent = target.Humanoid
			end

			return true, headshot, dead
		elseif target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Objects) then
			local lastHealth = target.Humanoid.Health
			local dead = false
			CombatTag:addTag(target, character, {damage = damage, weapon = tool.Name})
			target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
			if target.Humanoid.Health <= 0 and lastHealth > 0 then
				dead = true
			end

			return true, false, dead
		end
	end

	return false
end

Storage.Events.server.Event:Connect(function(type, ...)
	if type == "fire" then
		fire(...)
	elseif type == "damage" then
		damage(...)
	elseif type == "melee_damage" then
		meleeDamage(...)
	end
end)

Network:BindEvents({
	["fire"] = function(player, tool, dir)
		fire(player.Character, tool, player, dir)
	end,

	["robbing"] = function(player, seller)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

		if humanoid.RootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 and typeof(seller) == "Instance" and seller:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Characters.NPCs) and seller:FindFirstChild("cf_market") and seller.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
			if getDistance(humanoid.RootPart, seller.Humanoid.RootPart) <= 20 then
				seller.listeners.beingAimAt.update.Value = tick()
				seller.listeners.beingAimAt.robber.Value = player
				seller.listeners.beingAimAt.Value = true
			end
		end
	end,

	["grenade"] = function(player, tool, origin, dir)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

		if humanoid.RootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 and typeof(tool) == "Instance" and (tool:IsDescendantOf(character) or tool:IsDescendantOf(player.Backpack)) and tool:GetAttribute("Grenade") then
			handleGrenade(player, character, humanoid, tool, dir)
		end
	end,

	["vars"] = function(player, varType, data)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

		if varType == "clientsUpdate" then
			Network:FireOtherClients(player, "client", "updates", player.Character, data)
		elseif varType == "respawn" then
			if humanoid.Health > 0 and ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE:FindFirstChild(player.Name .. "-respawnCD") then
				return
			elseif humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local cd = Instance.new("StringValue")
				cd.Name = player.Name .. "-respawnCD"
				cd.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE
				task.wait(5)
				cd:Destroy()
			end

			player:LoadCharacter()
		elseif varType == "drown" then
			humanoid:TakeDamage(5)
			if character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
				_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.drown), character.Head):Play()
			end
		elseif varType == "reload" and data.tool and typeof(data.tool) == "Instance" and data.tool:FindFirstChild("Motor") and Storage.Modules.Weapons:FindFirstChild(data.tool.Name) then
			local _data = data.tool._data
			if typeof(data.state) == "boolean" then
				if _data.ammo.Value < 1 then
					return
				end

				_data.reload.Value = data.state
				_data.reload.reloading.Value = false
				if _data.reload.Value == true then
					local settings = require(Storage.Modules.Weapons[data.tool.Name])
					_data.reload.reloading.Value = true
					local loaded = false
					if settings.gunType == "rpg" and data.tool._mod:FindFirstChild("Rocket") then
						for _,v in pairs(data.tool._mod.Rocket:GetChildren()) do
							if v:IsA("BasePart") then
								v.Transparency = 0
							end
						end
					end
					local start = os.time()
					while character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and data.tool:IsDescendantOf(character) and _data.reload.reloading.Value == true and _data.reload.Value == true and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") do
						if os.time() - start >= (_data.magCurrent.Value > 0 and (settings.reloadTime / 2) or settings.reloadTime) then
							_data.reload.sv_complete.Value = true
							if _data.reload.cl_complete.Value == true then
								loaded = true
								_data.reload.cl_complete.Value = false
								_data.reload.sv_complete.Value = false
								--[[local needAmmo = _data.magSize.Value - _data.magCurrent.Value
								_data.magCurrent.Value = math.min(_data.magCurrent.Value + _data.ammo.Value, _data.magSize.Value)
								_data.ammo.Value = math.max(_data.ammo.Value - needAmmo, 0)]]
								if not settings.shotgun then
									_data.magCurrent.Value = _data.magSize.Value
									_data.ammo.Value = math.max(_data.ammo.Value - 1, 0)
								end
								--print("server-side reloaded")

								break
							end
						end

						task.wait(1 / 15)
					end

					if _data:IsDescendantOf(game) then
						if not loaded and settings.gunType == "rpg" and data.tool._mod:FindFirstChild("Rocket") then
							for _,v in pairs(data.tool._mod.Rocket:GetChildren()) do
								if v:IsA("BasePart") then
									v.Transparency = 1
								end
							end
						end
						_data.reload.reloading.Value = false
						_data.reload.Value = false
						_data.reload.cl_complete.Value = false
						_data.reload.sv_complete.Value = false
					end
				end
			elseif _data.reload.sv_complete.Value == true and data.client == true then
				_data.reload.cl_complete.Value = true
			elseif _data.reload.reloading.Value == true and data.add == true and _data.ammo.Value > 0 and _data.magCurrent.Value < _data.magSize.Value then
				_data.magCurrent.Value += 1
				_data.ammo.Value = math.max(_data.ammo.Value - 1, 0)
			end
		elseif varType == "sprint" and data.state then
			if not humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") then
				local sessionProfile = ReplicatedStorage.__profiles:WaitForChild(player.Name)
				if data.state == "ye" and not sessionProfile.stamina:GetAttribute("sprinting") and sessionProfile.stamina.Value > 0 then
					humanoid:SetAttribute("Speed", 20)
					sessionProfile.stamina:SetAttribute("sprinting", true)

					while humanoid:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and sessionProfile.stamina:GetAttribute("sprinting") and sessionProfile.stamina.Value > 0 and humanoid.Health > 0 and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") do
						sessionProfile.stamina:SetAttribute("tick", tick())
						sessionProfile.stamina.Value = math.max(sessionProfile.stamina.Value - 0.3, 0)
						task.wait(1 / 15)
					end

					--print("server stamina is out")
					sessionProfile.stamina:SetAttribute("sprinting", false)
					humanoid:SetAttribute("Speed", game:GetService("StarterPlayer").CharacterWalkSpeed)
				elseif data.state == "nah" and sessionProfile.stamina:GetAttribute("sprinting") then
					sessionProfile.stamina:SetAttribute("sprinting", false)
					humanoid:SetAttribute("Speed", game:GetService("StarterPlayer").CharacterWalkSpeed)
				end
			end
		elseif varType == "finish_normal" and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.RootPart and data.target and data.target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Characters) and (data.target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") or data.target.Humanoid.Health <= 0) and getDistance(humanoid.RootPart, data.target.Humanoid.RootPart) <= 11 then
			local melee = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
			if melee and melee:GetAttribute("Melee") and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].finish.Value == false then
				ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].finish.Value = true
				local t = tick()
				while melee:IsDescendantOf(character) and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.RootPart and tick() - t < 5 and ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].finish.Value == true do
					task.wait(1 / 15)
				end

				pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].finish.Value = false end)
			end
		elseif varType == "fall" and data.damage and isRealNumber(data.damage) and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Carried") then
			local lastHealth = humanoid.Health
			if lastHealth > 0 then
				Network:FireAllClients("client", "createSound", getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.bone_cracks), humanoid.RootPart)
			end
			humanoid:TakeDamage(math.clamp(data.damage, 0, math.huge))
			flinch("", character)

			-- R15 Fix: Fall damage now checks for LeftLowerLeg or RightLowerLeg
			if character:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerLeg") then
				character["LeftLowerLeg"]:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(character["LeftLowerLeg"]:GetAttribute("Health") - (data.damage * 2), 0))
			elseif character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") then -- R6 Fallback
				character["LeftFoot"]:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(character["LeftFoot"]:GetAttribute("Health") - (data.damage * 2), 0))
			end

			if character:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg") then
				character["RightLowerLeg"]:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(character["RightLowerLeg"]:GetAttribute("Health") - (data.damage * 2), 0))
			elseif character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg") then -- R6 Fallback
				character["RightFoot"]:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(character["RightFoot"]:GetAttribute("Health") - (data.damage * 2), 0))
			end

			if lastHealth > 0 and humanoid.Health <= 0 and data.damage >= humanoid.MaxHealth / 1.25 then
				humanoid:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", false)
				task.wait(1 / 30)
				for _,part in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
					if part:GetAttribute("Limbs") and (string.find(part.Name, "Leg") or string.find(part.Name, "Foot")) then
						part:SetAttribute("Enabled", false)
						_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.fleshHits), part):Play()
						emitParticle("BloodHitEffect", nil, part.Position)
					end
				end
			end
		elseif varType == "dead" then
			if humanoid.RootPart then
				humanoid.RootPart:Destroy()
			end
		elseif varType == "pvp" and data.mode ~= nil and typeof(data.mode) == "boolean" then
			local playerPVP = ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].pvp
			if not data.mode and tick() - playerPVP:GetAttribute("timer") < 25 and not humanoid:FindFirstChild("inPvpMode") then
				return
			end

			if not data.mode then
				playerPVP:SetAttribute("timer", tick())
				task.wait(10)
				if humanoid:FindFirstChild("inPvpMode") then
					return
				end
			end

			playerPVP.Value = data.mode
		elseif varType == "breakGlass" and data.glass ~= nil and typeof(data.glass) == "Instance" and data.glass:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Buildings.Glass) and not data.glass:GetAttribute("Break") and humanoid.Health > 0 and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and character:FindFirstChild("Head") and typeof(data.t) == "Instance" and data.t:IsDescendantOf(character) and data.t:GetAttribute("Arms") then
			local settings = require(Storage.Modules.Weapons[data.t.Name])
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Buildings}
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist
			params.CollisionGroup = "Raycast"

			local cast = workspace:Raycast(character.Head.CFrame.p, data.glass.CFrame.p - character.Head.CFrame.p, params)
			if cast and cast.Instance == data.glass then
				_G.createSound(getRandomChild(Storage.Sounds.glass_hit), data.glass):Play()
				data.glass:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(data.glass:GetAttribute("Health") - (settings.chainsaw and data.glass:GetAttribute("MaxHealth") or settings.damage[1]), 0))
				if data.glass:GetAttribute("Health") <= 0 then
					Storage.Events.glass:Fire(data.glass, cast.Position, (data.glass.CFrame.p - character.Head.CFrame.p).unit * math.random(30, 40))
				end
			end
		elseif varType == "loadout" and (ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].pvp.Value == false or character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField")) then
			local numToLoadout = {
				[1] = "Primary",
				[2] = "Second Primary",
				[3] = "Secondary",
				[4] = "Melee",
				[5] = "Utility",
				[6] = "Miscs",
			}

			humanoid:UnequipTools()
			task.wait(1 / 15)
			for _,v in pairs(player.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("Tool") and v.Name ~= "Fists" and not v:GetAttribute("SpecialItem") then
					v:Destroy()
				end
			end

			for _,v in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("Tool") and v.Name ~= "Fists" and not v:GetAttribute("SpecialItem") then
					v:Destroy()
				end
			end

			for k = 1, 5 do
				if player.playerData.loadout[tostring(k)].Value ~= "" then
					local weapon = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE.weaponsInfo[numToLoadout[k]][player.playerData.loadout[tostring(k)].Value]
					if weapon:FindFirstChild("gamepassId") and isUserOwnedGamepass(player, weapon.gamepassId.Value) or not weapon:FindFirstChild("gamepassId") then
						giveTool(player.playerData.loadout[tostring(k)].Value, player)
					end
				end
			end
			if player.playerData.loadout["6"].Value ~= "" then
				local weapon = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE.weaponsInfo[numToLoadout[6]][player.playerData.loadout["6"].Value]
				if weapon:FindFirstChild("gamepassId") and isUserOwnedGamepass(player, weapon.gamepassId.Value) or not weapon:FindFirstChild("gamepassId") then
					giveArmor(player, player.playerData.loadout["6"]["type"].Value, player.playerData.loadout["6"].tier.Value)
				end
			end

			if player.gamepasses.VIP.Value == true then
				for k = 0, 0 do
					
				end
			end
		end
	end,
})

Network:BindFunctions({
	["damage"] = function(player, target, tool, hitPart, vel, result, dir)
		return damage(player, target, tool, hitPart, vel, result, dir)
	end,

	["melee_damage"] = function(player, target, tool, hitPart, dirV3, result)
		return meleeDamage(player, target, tool, hitPart, dirV3, result)
	end,

	["reqBuy"] = function(player, category, item, seller, type)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		local playerData = player.playerData
		if humanoid.RootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 and typeof(seller) == "Instance" and seller:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Characters.NPCs) and seller:FindFirstChild("cf_market") and seller.Humanoid.Health > 0 and getDistance(humanoid.RootPart, seller.Humanoid.RootPart) <= 8 then
			local marketType = seller.cf_market.marketType.Value
			if tostring(type) == "cv_st" and marketType == "cv_st" and GeneralStoreItems[category][item] then
				local itemData = GeneralStoreItems[category][item]
				if playerData.cash.Value >= itemData.price and seller.cf_market.ableToBuy.Value == true then
					playerData.cash.Value -= itemData.price
					giveTool(itemData.toolName, player)

					return true, {
						header = "PURCHASE SUCCESSFUL",
						header_color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 0),
						desc = "You've successfully purchased " .. item .. "!"
					}
				elseif seller.cf_market.ableToBuy.Value == false then
					return false, {
						header = "STORE UNAVAILABLE",
						desc = "You cannot buy items at this moment.",
						header_color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
					}
				else
					return false, {
						header = "INSUFFICIENT FUNDS",
						desc = "You don't have enough cash to purchase this item!",
						header_color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
					}
				end
			end
		end

		return false, {
			header = "UNEXPECTED ERROR",
			desc = "There was an unexpected error has occurred, please try again later.",
			header_color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		}
	end,

	["revive"] = function(player, target)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		if target == false then
			local reviveSession = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE.revive:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
			if reviveSession then
				reviveSession.cancel.Value = true
			end
		else
			if humanoid.RootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and character:FindFirstChild("Fists") and target.Humanoid.RootPart and target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and target.Humanoid.Health > 0 and getDistance(target.Humanoid.RootPart, humanoid.RootPart) < 6 and not playerHasActivity(player) then
				local reviveSession = StorageServer.Miscs.revive:Clone()
				reviveSession.Name = player.Name
				reviveSession.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE.revive
				local reviveSFX = Storage.Sounds.revive_loop:Clone()
				reviveSFX.Name = "reviveSFX"
				reviveSFX:SetAttribute("reviver", player.Name)
				reviveSFX.Parent = target.Humanoid.RootPart
				reviveSFX:Play()
				task.spawn(function()
					local reviveState = Instance.new("StringValue")
					reviveState.Name = "reviving"
					reviveState.Parent = target.Humanoid
					local success = false
					local start = tick()
					while reviveSession.cancel.Value == false and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and humanoid.RootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and character:FindFirstChild("Fists") and target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and target.Humanoid.RootPart and target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and target.Humanoid.Health > 0 and getDistance(target.Humanoid.RootPart, humanoid.RootPart) < 6 do
						local time = tick() - start
						reviveSession.currentTime.Value = time
						if time >= reviveSession.maxTime.Value then
							success = true
							break
						end
						task.wait(1 / 30)
					end
					reviveSession:Destroy()
					if success then
						target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("Downed", false)
					end
					reviveSFX:Destroy()
					reviveState:Destroy()
				end)

				return true, reviveSession
			end
		end

		return false
	end,

	["interact"] = function(player, interactObject)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

		if interactObject == false then
			local interactSession = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE.interact:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
			if interactSession then
				interactSession:Destroy()
			end

			return true
		else
			local object = interactObject:IsA("Model") and interactObject.PrimaryPart or interactObject
			if typeof(interactObject) == "Instance" and interactObject:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Objects) and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.RootPart and getDistance(humanoid.RootPart, object) < 10 then
				local canGet = true
				if interactObject.PromptData.HoldDuration > 0 then
					if playerHasActivity(player) then
						return false
					end

					local interactSession = StorageServer.Miscs.interact:Clone()
					interactSession.Name = player.Name
					interactSession.maxTime.Value = interactObject.PromptData.HoldDuration
					interactSession.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE.interact
					local success = false
					local start = tick()
					pcall(function()
						while interactSession.cancel.Value == false and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and humanoid.RootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 and interactObject:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and getDistance(humanoid.RootPart, object) < 10 do
							local time = tick() - start
							interactSession.currentTime.Value = time
							if time >= interactSession.maxTime.Value then
								success = true
								break
							end

							task.wait(1 / 30)
						end
					end)
					interactSession:Destroy()
					canGet = success
				end

				if canGet then
					if interactObject:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Objects.Ammo) then
						local gun = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
						if gun and gun:GetAttribute("Arms") and not gun:GetAttribute("Melee") then
							Network:FireAllClients("client", "createSound", Storage.Sounds.ammo_pickup, object)
							humanoid:UnequipTools()
							task.wait(1 / 30)
							gun:Destroy()
							local newTool = giveTool(gun.ToolTip, player)
							task.wait(1 / 30)
							humanoid:EquipTool(newTool)
							return true, {
								prop = {
									Text = "YOUR AMMO SUPPLY HAS BEEN REFILLED",
									TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(179, 255, 158),
								},
								err = false,
								dur = 3,
							}
						else
							return false, {
								prop = {
									Text = "UNABLE TO RESUPPLY AMMO",
									TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 153, 155),
								},
								err = true,
								dur = 3,
							}
						end
					elseif interactObject:GetAttribute("PVP") and not humanoid:FindFirstChild("inPvpMode") then
						local spawnPart = getRandomChild(workspace.Buildings.GlassHouseMap.Spawns)
						humanoid.RootPart.CFrame = spawnPart.CFrame

						local string = Instance.new("StringValue")
						string.Name = "inPvpMode"
						string.Parent = humanoid

						ReplicatedStorage.__profiles[player.Name].pvp.Value = true

						return true, {
							prop = {
								Text = "You have been teleported to PVP Arena",
								TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 255, 238),
							},
							err = false,
							dur = 3,
						}
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return false
	end,

	["varsFunction"] = function(player, varType, data)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

		if varType == "selfRevive" then
			if data.state then
				if humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.RootPart and not playerHasActivity(player) then
					local selfReviveSession = StorageServer.Miscs["self-revive"]:Clone()
					selfReviveSession.Name = player.Name
					selfReviveSession.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE["self-revive"]
					task.spawn(function()
						local success = false
						local start = tick()
						while selfReviveSession.cancel.Value == false and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and humanoid.RootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 --[[and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")]] and humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") do
							local time = tick() - start
							selfReviveSession.currentTime.Value = time
							if time >= selfReviveSession.maxTime.Value then
								success = true
								break
							end
							task.wait(1 / 30)
						end
						selfReviveSession:Destroy()
						if success then
							humanoid:SetAttribute("Downed", false)

							humanoid:SetAttribute("RagdollDur", 1.5)
							humanoid:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", true)
						end
					end)

					return true, selfReviveSession
				end
			else
				local selfReviveSession = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE["self-revive"]:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
				if selfReviveSession then
					selfReviveSession.cancel.Value = true
				end
			end
		elseif varType == "setWeapon" and data.itemName and data.loadoutType and data.weapon and data.weapon:IsDescendantOf(ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE.weaponsInfo) and (StorageServer.Tools.Public:FindFirstChild(data.loadoutType) or data.loadoutType == "Miscs") and (data.loadoutType == "Miscs" or findTool(StorageServer.Tools.Public[data.loadoutType], data.itemName) or data.unequip) then
			local loadoutToNum = {
				["Primary"] = 1,
				["Second Primary"] = 2,
				["Secondary"] = 3,
				["Melee"] = 4,
				["Utility"] = 5,
				["Miscs"] = 1,
			}

			player.playerData.loadout[loadoutToNum[data.loadoutType]].Value = data.unequip and "" or data.itemName
			if data.loadoutType == "Miscs" then
				player.playerData.loadout[loadoutToNum[data.loadoutType]]["type"].Value = data.weapon["type"].Value
				player.playerData.loadout[loadoutToNum[data.loadoutType]]["tier"].Value = data.weapon["tier"].Value
			end
			return true
		elseif varType == "carry" then
			if data.state and data.target and not playerHasActivity(player) then
				if not humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and not humanoid:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.RootPart and data.target.Humanoid.RootPart and data.target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Downed") and not data.target.Humanoid:GetAttribute("Carried") and data.target.Humanoid.Health > 0 and getDistance(data.target.Humanoid.RootPart, humanoid.RootPart) < 5 then
					_G.createSound(Storage.Sounds.carry, humanoid.RootPart):Play()
					-- Note: Update these animation IDs for R15 carry poses
					local carryStart = loadAnim(humanoid.Animator, 15531368505)
					carryStart:Play()

					local animator = data.target.Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")
					loadAnim(animator, 15531375922):Play()
					humanoid:UnequipTools()
					local carrySession = StorageServer.Miscs.carry:Clone()
					carrySession.Name = player.Name
					carrySession.carryOwner.Value = character
					carrySession.carryTarget.Value = data.target
					carrySession.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.__tempSTORAGE.carry
					data.target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", false)
					data.target.Humanoid:SetAttribute("Carried", true)
					data.target.Humanoid.RootPart:SetNetworkOwner(player)
					data.target.Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
					data.target.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
					local parts = {}
					for _,v in pairs(data.target:GetDescendants()) do
						if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Massless then
							v.Massless = true
							parts[#parts + 1] = v
						end
					end
					local carried_anim = loadAnim(animator, 15531379500)
					local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
